title.zh: 卷四 本紀第四 則天皇后 中宗
title.en: Volume 4 Annals 4: Empress Wu Zetian, Zhongzong
title.raw: 卷四 本紀第四 則天皇后 中宗 Volume 4 Annals 4: Empress Wu Zetian, Zhongzong

sentences.zh: __FORCETOC__則天皇后則天順聖皇后武氏諱曌，幷州文水人也。

translations.literal: __FORCETOC__Empress Wu Zetian, Empress Zetian the Shun Sheng, the Wu clan taboo name Zhao, was a native of Wenshui in Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: __FORCETOC__Empress Wu Zetian, posthumously honored as Empress Zetian the Shun Sheng, bore the taboo name Zhao and was of the Wu clan. She came from Wenshui in Bingzhou.

sentences.zh: 父士彠，官至工部尚書、荊州都督，封應國公。

translations.literal: His father was Shi Hu, who reached the posts of minister of works and military governor of Jingzhou and was enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: His father was Wu Shihuo, who served as minister of works and military governor of Jingzhou and was enfeoffed as Duke of Ying.

sentences.zh: 后年十四，太宗聞其有色，選為才人。

translations.literal: When the empress was fourteen, Taizong heard of her beauty and selected her as a court lady of talent.
translations.idiomatic: When she was fourteen Taizong heard of her beauty and selected her as a court lady of talent.

sentences.zh: 太宗崩，后削髮為比丘尼，居于感業寺。

translations.literal: When Taizong died, the empress shaved her head and became a Buddhist nun, dwelling at Ganye Temple.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong died she shaved her head and became a Buddhist nun, dwelling at Ganye Temple.

sentences.zh: 高宗幸感業寺，見而悅之，復召入宮。

translations.literal: Gaozong visited Ganye Temple, saw her and was pleased, and recalled her to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong visited Ganye Temple, saw her and was pleased, and recalled her to the palace.

sentences.zh: 久之，立為昭儀，進號宸妃。

translations.literal: After some time she was established as Lady of Bright Deportment and advanced to the title Imperial Consort.
translations.idiomatic: After some time she was made Lady of Bright Deportment and advanced to the title of Imperial Consort.

sentences.zh: 永徽六年，高宗廢皇后王氏，立宸妃為皇后。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yonghui, Gaozong deposed Empress Wang and established Imperial Consort as empress.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Yonghui Gaozong deposed Empress Wang and established Imperial Consort Wu as empress.

sentences.zh: 高宗自顯慶後，多苦風疾，百司奏事，時時令后決之，常稱旨，由是參豫國政。

translations.literal: After Xianqing, Gaozong often suffered from wind affliction; when the hundred offices reported affairs he frequently had the empress decide them, and she often matched his intent, whereupon she participated in state governance.
translations.idiomatic: After Xianqing Gaozong often suffered from wind affliction. When the hundred offices reported affairs he frequently had the empress decide them, and she often matched his intent; thereby she came to participate in state governance.

sentences.zh: 后既專寵與政，乃數上書言天下利害，務收人心，而高宗春秋高，苦疾，后益用事，遂不能制。

translations.literal: Once the empress had exclusive favor and a share in government, she repeatedly submitted memorials on the benefits and harms under heaven, striving to win hearts; Gaozong's years were advanced and he suffered illness, the empress increasingly handled affairs, and he ultimately could not control her.
translations.idiomatic: Once the empress held exclusive favor and a share in government, she repeatedly submitted memorials on the benefits and harms under heaven, striving to win hearts. Gaozong's years were advanced and he suffered illness; the empress increasingly handled affairs, and he ultimately could not restrain her.

sentences.zh: 高宗悔，陰欲廢之，而謀洩不果。

translations.literal: Gaozong regretted it and secretly wished to depose her, but the plot leaked and did not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Gaozong regretted it and secretly wished to depose her, but the plot leaked and did not succeed.

sentences.zh: 上元元年，高宗號天皇，皇后亦號天后，天下之人謂之「二聖」。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shangyuan, Gaozong styled himself Heavenly Sovereign and the empress also styled herself Heavenly Empress; the people of all under heaven called them the "Two Sages."
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shangyuan Gaozong styled himself Heavenly Sovereign and the empress styled herself Heavenly Empress. The people of all under heaven called them the "Two Sages."

sentences.zh: 弘道元年弘道元年十二月，高宗崩，遺詔皇太子即皇帝位，軍國大務不決者，兼取天后進止。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongdao, in the twelfth month of the first year of Hongdao, Gaozong died; the testament decree ordered the crown prince to immediately take the emperor's position, and for great military and state matters left undecided, jointly follow the Heavenly Empress's decisions.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the first year of Hongdao Gaozong died. His testament decree ordered the crown prince to ascend the throne immediately; for great military and state matters left undecided, the Heavenly Empress's decisions were to be followed jointly.

sentences.zh: 甲子，皇太子即皇帝位，尊后為皇太后，臨朝稱制。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi the crown prince took the emperor's position, honored the empress as empress dowager, and held court to rule by decree.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi the crown prince ascended the throne, honored the empress as empress dowager, and held court to rule by decree.

sentences.zh: 大赦，賜九品以下勳官一級。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed; officials of merit rank below the ninth grade were granted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and officials of merit rank below the ninth grade were granted one rank.

sentences.zh: 庚午，韓王元嘉為太尉，霍王元軌為司徒，舒王元名為司空。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Prince of Han Yuanjia was made Grand Commandant, Prince of Huo Yuan Gui was made Minister of Education, and Prince of Shu Yuanming was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu Yuanjia, Prince of Han, was appointed Grand Commandant; Yuan Gui, Prince of Huo, Minister of Education; and Yuanming, Prince of Shu, Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，劉仁軌為尚書左僕射，裴炎為中書令，劉齊賢為侍中：同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Liu Ren'gui was made left vice director of the Department of State, Pei Yan was made secretariat director, and Liu Qixian was made palace attendant: all associates of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu Liu Ren'gui was appointed left vice director of the Department of State, Pei Yan secretariat director, and Liu Qixian palace attendant, all as associates of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，郭待舉、魏玄同、岑長倩同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Guo Daiju, Wei Xuantong, and Cen Changqian were made associates of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin Guo Daiju, Wei Xuantong, and Cen Changqian were appointed associates of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 癸未，郭正一罷。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Guo Zhengyi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei Guo Zhengyi was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 光宅元年光宅元年正月癸未，改元嗣聖。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangzhai, in the first year of Guangzhai on the day guiwei in the first month, the era name was changed to Sisheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Guangzhai, on the day guiwei in the first month, the era name was changed to Sisheng.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，左散騎常侍韋弘敏為太府卿、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Left Attendant-in-Ordinary Wei Hongmin was made minister of the palace storehouse and associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi Wei Hongmin, left attendant-in-ordinary, was appointed minister of the palace storehouse and associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，廢皇帝為廬陵王，幽之。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu in the second month, the emperor was deposed as Prince of Luling and confined.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu in the second month the emperor was deposed as Prince of Luling and confined.

sentences.zh: 己未，立豫王旦為皇帝，妃劉氏為皇后，立永平郡王成器為皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Prince of Yu Dan was established as emperor, his consort Lady Liu as empress, and Prince of Yongping Chengqi as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei Dan, Prince of Yu, was established as emperor; his consort Lady Liu of the Liu clan was made empress; and Chengqi, Prince of Yongping, was established as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元為文明。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Wenming.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Wenming.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官五品以上爵一等、九品以上勳兩轉。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials of the fifth rank and above were granted one degree of nobility; officials of merit rank of the ninth rank and above were granted two degrees of merit.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials of the fifth rank and above were granted one degree of nobility, and officials of merit rank of the ninth rank and above were granted two degrees of merit.

sentences.zh: 老人版授官，賜粟帛。

translations.literal: Offices were conferred on the elderly by age register, and grain and silk were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Offices were conferred on the elderly by age register, and grain and silk were granted.

sentences.zh: 職官五品以上舉所知一人。

translations.literal: Officials of the fifth rank and above were to recommend one person they knew.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the fifth rank and above were to recommend one person they knew.

sentences.zh: 皇太后仍臨朝稱制。

translations.literal: The empress dowager continued to hold court and rule by decree.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager continued to hold court and rule by decree.

sentences.zh: 庚申，廢皇太孫重照為庶人，殺庶人賢于巴州。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, the imperial grandson Chongzhao was deposed and made a commoner; the commoner Xian was killed at Bazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen the imperial grandson Chongzhao was deposed and reduced to commoner status, and the commoner Li Xian was killed at Bazhou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，皇帝率羣臣上尊號于武成殿。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the emperor led the multitude of officials to offer elevated honorific titles at Wucheng Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi the emperor led the multitude of officials to offer elevated honorific titles at Wucheng Hall.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，冊皇帝。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the emperor was formally enthroned.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao the emperor was formally enthroned.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太常卿王德真為侍中，中書侍郎劉禕之同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Minister of Rites Wang Dezheng was made palace attendant, and Secretariat Secretary Liu Yizhi was made associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou Wang Dezheng, minister of rites, was appointed palace attendant, and Liu Yizhi, secretariat secretary, was appointed associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，贈玉清觀道士太中大夫王遠知金紫光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Wang Yuanzhi, grand master and Daoist priest of the Jade Purity Abbey, was posthumously granted the title grand master of splendid happiness with the golden seal and purple ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen Wang Yuanzhi, grand master and Daoist priest of the Jade Purity Abbey, was posthumously granted the title grand master of splendid happiness with the golden seal and purple ribbon.

sentences.zh: 三月丁亥，徙封上金為畢王，素節葛王。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the third month, Shangjin was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Bi, and Sujie as Prince of Ge.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai in the third month Shangjin was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Bi, and Sujie as Prince of Ge.

sentences.zh: 四月丁巳，滕王元嬰薨。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the fourth month, Prince of Teng Yuan Ying died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi in the fourth month Yuan Ying, Prince of Teng, died.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，徙封上金為澤王，素節許王。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Shangjin was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Ze, and Sujie as Prince of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou Shangjin was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Ze, and Sujie as Prince of Xu.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，遷廬陵王于房州；

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the Prince of Luling was moved to Fangzhou;
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou the Prince of Luling was moved to Fangzhou;

sentences.zh: 丁丑，又遷于均州。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, he was moved again to Junzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou he was moved again to Junzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，以大喪禁射獵。

translations.literal: On the day guisi in the fifth month, hunting was prohibited because of the great mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi in the fifth month hunting was prohibited because of the great mourning.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲子，禮部尚書武承嗣為太常卿、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi in the intercalary month, Minister of Rites Wu Chengsi was made minister of rites and associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi in the intercalary month Wu Chengsi, minister of rites, was appointed minister of rites and associate of the secretariat and chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 七月戊午，廣州崑崙殺其都督路元叡。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu in the seventh month, the Kunlun people of Guangzhou killed their military governor Lu Yuanrui.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu in the seventh month the Kunlun people of Guangzhou killed their military governor Lu Yuanrui.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，突厥寇朔州，左武衞大將軍程務挺敗之。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, the Turks raided Shuozhou; Cheng Wuting, grand general of the Left Martial Guard, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou the Turks raided Shuozhou. Cheng Wuting, grand general of the Left Martial Guard, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 辛未，有彗星出于西方。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, a comet appeared in the west.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei a comet appeared in the west.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，葬天皇大帝于乾陵。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin in the eighth month, the Heavenly Sovereign Grand Emperor was buried at Qianling.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin in the eighth month the Heavenly Sovereign Grand Emperor was buried at Qianling.

sentences.zh: 丙午，武承嗣罷。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Wu Chengsi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu Wu Chengsi was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the ninth month, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin in the ninth month a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 旗幟尚白，易內外官服青者以碧，大易官名，改東都為神都。

translations.literal: Banners and flags honored white; inner and outer official robes that had been green were changed to blue-green; official names were greatly changed; and the Eastern Capital was renamed the Divine Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Banners and flags honored white; inner and outer official robes that had been green were changed to blue-green; official names were greatly changed; and the Eastern Capital was renamed the Divine Capital.

sentences.zh: 追尊老子母為先天太后。

translations.literal: Laozi's mother was posthumously honored as Empress of Prior Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Laozi's mother was posthumously honored as Empress of Prior Heaven.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，左威衞大將軍程務挺為單于道安撫大使，以備突厥。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Cheng Wuting, grand general of the Left Awesome Guard, was made pacification commissioner of the Chanyu Route to guard against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen Cheng Wuting, grand general of the Left Awesome Guard, was appointed pacification commissioner of the Chanyu Route to guard against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 己巳，追尊武氏五代祖克己為魯國公，妣裴氏為魯國夫人；

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Wu's fifth-generation ancestor Keji was posthumously honored as Duke of Lu, and his mother Lady Pei as Lady of Lu;
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi Wu's fifth-generation ancestor Keji was posthumously honored as Duke of Lu, and his mother Lady Pei of the Pei clan as Lady of Lu;

sentences.zh: 高祖居常為太尉、北平郡王，妣劉氏為王妃；

translations.literal: the great-great-grandfather Juchang was made Grand Commandant and Prince of Beiping commandery, and his mother Lady Liu was styled princess consort;
translations.idiomatic: the great-great-grandfather Juchang was made Grand Commandant and Prince of Beiping commandery, and his mother Lady Liu of the Liu clan was styled princess consort;

sentences.zh: 曾祖儉為太尉、金城郡王，妣宋氏為王妃；

translations.literal: the great-grandfather Jian was made Grand Commandant and Prince of Jincheng commandery, and his mother Lady Song was styled princess consort;
translations.idiomatic: the great-grandfather Jian was made Grand Commandant and Prince of Jincheng commandery, and his mother Lady Song of the Song clan was styled princess consort;

sentences.zh: 祖華為太尉、太原郡王，妣趙氏為王妃；

translations.literal: the grandfather Hua was made Grand Commandant and Prince of Taiyuan commandery, and his mother Lady Zhao was styled princess consort;
translations.idiomatic: the grandfather Hua was made Grand Commandant and Prince of Taiyuan commandery, and his mother Lady Zhao of the Zhao clan was styled princess consort;

sentences.zh: 考士彠為太師、魏王，妣楊氏為王妃。

translations.literal: her deceased father Shi Hu was made Grand Preceptor and Prince of Wei, and his mother Lady Yang was styled princess consort.
translations.idiomatic: her deceased father Shi Hu was made Grand Preceptor and Prince of Wei, and his mother Lady Yang of the Yang clan was styled princess consort.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，柳州司馬李敬業舉兵于揚州以討亂。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Li Jingye, acting prefect of Liuzhou, raised troops at Yangzhou to suppress the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou Li Jingye, acting prefect of Liuzhou, raised troops at Yangzhou to suppress the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 貶韋弘敏為汾州刺史。

translations.literal: Wei Hongmin was demoted to prefect of Fenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Hongmin was demoted to prefect of Fenzhou.

sentences.zh: 十月癸未，楚州司馬李崇福以山陽、安宜、鹽城三縣歸于敬業。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei in the tenth month, Li Chongfu, acting prefect of Chuzhou, surrendered Shanyang, Anyi, and Yancheng counties to Jingye.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei in the tenth month Li Chongfu, acting prefect of Chuzhou, surrendered Shanyang, Anyi, and Yancheng counties to Jingye.

sentences.zh: 甲申，左玉鈐衞大將軍梁郡公孝逸為揚州道行軍大總管，左金吾衞大將軍李知十為副，率兵三十萬以拒李敬業。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Xiaoyi, Duke of Liang commandery and grand general of the Left Jade Seal Guard, was made campaign commander-in-chief of the Yangzhou Route; Li Zhishi, grand general of the Left Golden Wild Goose Guard, was made his deputy; they led three hundred thousand troops to resist Li Jingye.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen Xiaoyi, Duke of Liang commandery and grand general of the Left Jade Seal Guard, was appointed campaign commander-in-chief of the Yangzhou Route, with Li Zhishi, grand general of the Left Golden Wild Goose Guard, as his deputy. They led three hundred thousand troops to resist Li Jingye.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，左肅政臺御史大夫騫味道檢校內史、同鳳閣鸞臺三品，鳳閣舍人李景諶同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Qian Weidao, censor-in-chief of the Left Rectification Censorate, was made acting secretariat director and associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank; Li Jingchen, secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion, was made co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai Qian Weidao, censor-in-chief of the Left Rectification Censorate, was appointed acting secretariat director and associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank; Li Jingchen, secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion, was appointed co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，李敬業克潤州。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Li Jingye captured Runzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen Li Jingye captured Runzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，殺裴炎。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Pei Yan was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen Pei Yan was killed.

sentences.zh: 追謚五代祖魯國公曰靖，高祖北平郡王曰恭肅，曾祖金城郡王曰義康，祖太原郡王曰安成，考魏王曰忠孝。

translations.literal: The fifth-generation Duke of Lu was posthumously given the posthumous name Jing; the Prince of Beiping commandery Gongs; the Prince of Jincheng commandery Yikang; the Prince of Taiyuan commandery Ancheng; and the Prince of Wei Zhongxiao.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth-generation Duke of Lu was posthumously given the name Jing; the Prince of Beiping commandery Gongs; the Prince of Jincheng commandery Yikang; the Prince of Taiyuan commandery Ancheng; and the Prince of Wei Zhongxiao.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，曲赦揚、楚二州。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Yang and Chu prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Yang and Chu prefectures.

sentences.zh: 復敬業姓徐氏。

translations.literal: Jingye's surname was restored to Xu.
translations.idiomatic: Jingye's surname was restored to Xu.

sentences.zh: 貶劉齊賢為辰州刺史。

translations.literal: Liu Qixian was demoted to prefect of Chenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Qixian was demoted to prefect of Chenzhou.

sentences.zh: 李景諶罷。

translations.literal: Li Jingchen was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jingchen was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 右史沈君諒、著作郎崔詧為正諫大夫、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Right Historian Shen Junliang and Compilation Director Cui Zan were made remonstrance grand masters and co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Junliang, right historian, and Cui Zan, compilation director, were appointed remonstrance grand masters and co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛亥，左鷹揚衞大將軍黑齒常之為江南道行軍大總管。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the eleventh month, Heichi Changzhi, grand general of the Left Eagle-raising Guard, was made campaign commander-in-chief of the Jiangnan Route.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai in the eleventh month Heichi Changzhi, grand general of the Left Eagle-raising Guard, was appointed campaign commander-in-chief of the Jiangnan Route.

sentences.zh: 庚申，右監門衞將軍蘇孝祥及徐敬業戰于阿谿，死之。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Su Xiaoxiang, right gate guard general, fought Xu Jingye at Axi Creek and died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen Su Xiaoxiang, right gate guard general, fought Xu Jingye at Axi Creek and was killed.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，徐敬業將王那相殺敬業降。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Xu Jingye's general Wang Nashang killed Jingye and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou Xu Jingye's general Wang Nashang killed Jingye and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，郭待舉罷。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Guo Daiju was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao Guo Daiju was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 鸞臺侍郎韋方質為鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Wei Fangzhi, secretary of the Luan Terrace, was made secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Fangzhi, secretary of the Luan Terrace, was appointed secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，遣御史察風俗。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi in the twelfth month, censors were dispatched to inspect local customs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi in the twelfth month censors were dispatched to inspect local customs.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，殺程務挺。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Cheng Wuting was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao Cheng Wuting was killed.

sentences.zh: 垂拱元年垂拱元年正月丁未，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chuigong, in the first year of Chuigong on the day dingwei in the first month, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chuigong, on the day dingwei in the first month, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，騫味道守內史。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Qian Weidao served as secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu Qian Weidao served as secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，劉仁軌薨。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Liu Ren'gui died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen Liu Ren'gui died.

sentences.zh: 二月乙巳，春官尚書武承嗣、秋官尚書裴居道、右肅政臺御史大夫韋思謙同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: On the day yisi in the second month, Wu Chengsi, minister of the spring office, Pei Judao, minister of the autumn office, and Wei Siqian, censor-in-chief of the Right Rectification Censorate, were made associates of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi in the second month Wu Chengsi, minister of the spring office, Pei Judao, minister of the autumn office, and Wei Siqian, censor-in-chief of the Right Rectification Censorate, were appointed associates of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 突厥寇邊，左玉鈐衞中郎將淳于處平為陽曲道行軍總管以擊之。

translations.literal: The Turks raided the frontier; Chunyu Chuping, middle commander of the Left Jade Seal Guard, was made campaign commander of the Yangqu Route to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks raided the frontier. Chunyu Chuping, middle commander of the Left Jade Seal Guard, was appointed campaign commander of the Yangqu Route to attack them.

sentences.zh: 沈君諒罷。

translations.literal: Shen Junliang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Junliang was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 三月，崔詧罷。

translations.literal: In the third month, Cui Zan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Cui Zan was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，遷廬陵王于房州。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the Prince of Luling was moved to Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen the Prince of Luling was moved to Fangzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，武承嗣罷。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Wu Chengsi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou Wu Chengsi was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 辛未，頒垂拱格。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the Chuigong Code was promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei the Chuigong Code was promulgated.

sentences.zh: 四月丙子，貶騫味道為青州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi in the fourth month, Qian Weidao was demoted to prefect of Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi in the fourth month Qian Weidao was demoted to prefect of Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 癸未，淳于處平及突厥戰于忻州，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Chunyu Chuping fought the Turks at Xinzhou and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei Chunyu Chuping fought the Turks at Xinzhou and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，裴居道為納言。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu in the fifth month, Pei Judao was made chancellery director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu in the fifth month Pei Judao was appointed chancellery director.

sentences.zh: 丁未，流王德真于象州。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Wang Dezheng was exiled to Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei Wang Dezheng was exiled to Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，冬官尚書蘇良嗣守納言。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Su Liangsi, minister of the winter office, served as acting chancellery director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou Su Liangsi, minister of the winter office, served as acting chancellery director.

sentences.zh: 封皇帝子成義為恆王。

translations.literal: The emperor's son Chengyi was enfeoffed as Prince of Heng.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's son Chengyi was enfeoffed as Prince of Heng.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以旱慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, because of drought prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu, because of drought, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 壬申，韋方質同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Wei Fangzhi was made associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen Wei Fangzhi was appointed associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 六月，天官尚書韋待價同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Wei Daijia, minister of the celestial office, was made associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Wei Daijia, minister of the celestial office, was appointed associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 九月丁卯，揚州地生毛。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao in the ninth month, hair grew from the ground in Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao in the ninth month hair grew from the ground in Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯，韋待價為燕然道行軍大總管，以擊突厥。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the eleventh month, Wei Daijia was made campaign commander-in-chief of the Yanran Route to attack the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao in the eleventh month Wei Daijia was appointed campaign commander-in-chief of the Yanran Route to attack the Turks.

sentences.zh: 垂拱二年二年正月辛酉，大赦，賜酺三日，內外官勳一轉。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chuigong, in the second year on the day xinyou in the first month, a general amnesty was proclaimed, three days of festive drinking were granted, and inner and outer officials were granted one degree of merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chuigong, on the day xinyou in the first month, a general amnesty was proclaimed, three days of festive drinking were granted, and inner and outer officials were granted one degree of merit.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the first day of the second month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei, the first day of the second month, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 三月戊申，作銅匭。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the third month, bronze boxes were made.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen in the third month bronze suggestion boxes were made.

sentences.zh: 四月庚辰，岑長倩為內史。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen in the fourth month, Cen Changqian was made secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen in the fourth month Cen Changqian was appointed secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，裴居道為內史。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu in the fifth month, Pei Judao was made secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu in the fifth month Pei Judao was appointed secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 六月辛未，蘇良嗣同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei in the sixth month, Su Liangsi was made associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei in the sixth month Su Liangsi was appointed associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 己卯，韋思謙守納言。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Wei Siqian served as acting chancellery director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao Wei Siqian served as acting chancellery director.

sentences.zh: 十月己巳，有山出于新豐縣，改新豐為慶山，赦囚，給復一年，賜酺三日。

translations.literal: On the day jisi in the tenth month, a mountain emerged in Xinfeng county. Xinfeng was renamed Qingshan. Prisoners were pardoned, corvée and tax levies were remitted for one year, and a three-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi in the tenth month a mountain emerged in Xinfeng county. The county was renamed Qingshan, prisoners were pardoned, corvée and tax levies were remitted for one year, and a three-day drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 十二月，免幷州百姓庸、調，終其身。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, corvée and tax levies for the people of Bingzhou were remitted for the rest of their lives.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month corvée and tax levies for the people of Bingzhou were remitted for the rest of their lives.

sentences.zh: 是冬，無雪。

translations.literal: That winter there was no snow.
translations.idiomatic: That winter there was no snow.

sentences.zh: 垂拱三年三年閏正月丁卯，封皇帝子隆基為楚王，隆範衞王，隆業趙王。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao in the intercalary first month of the third year of Chuigong, the emperor's sons were enfeoffed: Longji as Prince of Chu, Longfan as Prince of Wei, and Longye as Prince of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao in the intercalary first month of the third year of Chuigong the emperor's sons were enfeoffed: Longji as Prince of Chu, Longfan as Prince of Wei, and Longye as Prince of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，以旱避正殿，減膳。

translations.literal: On the day jihai in the second month, because of drought the main hall was vacated and the imperial diet was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai in the second month, because of drought, the emperor vacated the main hall and reduced the imperial diet.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，突厥寇昌平，黑齒常之擊之。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the Turks raided Changping. Heichi Changzhi attacked them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen the Turks raided Changping, and Heichi Changzhi attacked them.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，韋思謙罷。

translations.literal: On the day yichou in the third month, Wei Siqian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou in the third month Wei Siqian was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 四月辛丑，追號孝敬皇帝妃裴氏曰哀皇后，葬于恭陵。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou in the fourth month, the consort Pei of Emperor Xiaojing was posthumously titled Empress Ai and was buried at Gongling.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou in the fourth month the consort Pei of Emperor Xiaojing was posthumously titled Empress Ai and buried at Gongling.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以旱慮囚，命京官九品以上言事。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, because of drought prisoners were reviewed, and capital officials of the ninth rank and above were ordered to submit memorials.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou, because of drought, prisoners were reviewed and capital officials of the ninth rank and above were ordered to submit memorials.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，裴居道為納言。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Pei Judao was made chancellery director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu Pei Judao was appointed chancellery director.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，夏官侍郎張光輔為鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin in the fifth month, Zhang Guangfu, vice minister of the summer office, was made secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin in the fifth month Zhang Guangfu, vice minister of the summer office, was appointed secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚午，殺劉禕之。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Liu Yizhi was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu Liu Yizhi was killed.

sentences.zh: 七月丁卯，冀州雌雞化為雄。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao in the seventh month, a hen in Jizhou transformed into a rooster.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao in the seventh month a hen in Jizhou transformed into a rooster.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，京師地震，雨金于廣州。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the capital was shaken by an earthquake, and gold rained down at Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai the capital was shaken by an earthquake, and gold rained down at Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子，魏玄同兼檢校納言。

translations.literal: On the day renzi in the eighth month, Wei Xuantong additionally served as supervisory chancellery director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi in the eighth month Wei Xuantong additionally served as supervisory chancellery director.

sentences.zh: 交趾人李嗣仙殺安南都護劉延祐，據交州，桂州司馬曹玄靜敗之。

translations.literal: Li Sixian of Jiaozhi killed Protector-General of Annan Liu Yanyou, seized Jiaozhou, and was defeated by Cao Xuanjing, military aide of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Sixian of Jiaozhi killed Protector-General of Annan Liu Yanyou and seized Jiaozhou, but was defeated by Cao Xuanjing, military aide of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，突厥寇朔州，燕然道行軍大總管黑齒常之敗之。

translations.literal: That month the Turks raided Shuozhou. Heichi Changzhi, campaign commander-in-chief of the Yanran Route, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Turks raided Shuozhou, and Heichi Changzhi, campaign commander-in-chief of the Yanran Route, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，虢州人楊初成自稱郎將，募州人迎廬陵王于房州，不果，見殺。

translations.literal: On the day jimao in the ninth month, Yang Chucheng of Guozhou styled himself a commandant, recruited men of the prefecture to welcome the Prince of Luling from Fangzhou, failed, and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao in the ninth month Yang Chucheng of Guozhou styled himself a commandant and recruited men of the prefecture to welcome the Prince of Luling from Fangzhou. The plot failed and he was killed.

sentences.zh: 十月庚子，右監門衞中郎將爨寶璧及突厥戰，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi in the tenth month, Cuan Baobi, middle commander of the Right Gate Guard, fought the Turks and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi in the tenth month Cuan Baobi, middle commander of the Right Gate Guard, fought the Turks and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，韋待價為安息道行軍大總管，安西大都護閻溫古副之，以擊吐蕃。

translations.literal: On the day renchen in the twelfth month, Wei Daigu was made campaign commander-in-chief of the Anxi Route, with Protector-General of Anxi Yan Wengu as his deputy, to attack the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen in the twelfth month Wei Daigu was appointed campaign commander-in-chief of the Anxi Route, with Protector-General of Anxi Yan Wengu as his deputy, to attack the Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大饑。

translations.literal: That year there was a great famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year there was a great famine.

sentences.zh: 垂拱四年四年正月甲子，增七廟，立高祖、太宗、高宗廟于神都。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi in the first month of the fourth year of Chuigong, the ancestral temples were increased to seven, and temples to Gaozu, Taizong, and Gaozong were established at Shendu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi in the first month of the fourth year of Chuigong the ancestral temples were increased to seven, and temples to Gaozu, Taizong, and Gaozong were established at Shendu.

sentences.zh: 庚午，毀乾元殿，作明堂。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the Qianyuan Hall was demolished and the Bright Hall was built.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu the Qianyuan Hall was demolished and the Bright Hall was built.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，殺麟臺少監周思茂。

translations.literal: On the day renxu in the third month, Zhou Simao, deputy director of the Forest Terrace, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu in the third month Zhou Simao, deputy director of the Forest Terrace, was killed.

sentences.zh: 四月戊戌，殺太子通事舍人郝象賢。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu in the fourth month, Hao Xiangxian, palace attendant of the crown prince, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu in the fourth month Hao Xiangxian, palace attendant of the crown prince, was killed.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，得「寶圖」于洛水。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen in the fifth month, the "Treasure Chart" was obtained from the Luo River.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen in the fifth month the "Treasure Chart" was obtained from the Luo River.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，加尊號為聖母神皇。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the honorific title Holy Mother Divine Emperor was added.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai the honorific title Holy Mother Divine Emperor was added.

sentences.zh: 六月丁亥朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day dinghai in the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day dinghai in the sixth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 得瑞石于汜水。

translations.literal: An auspicious stone was obtained at Sishui.
translations.idiomatic: An auspicious stone was obtained at Sishui.

sentences.zh: 七月丁巳，大赦，改「寶圖」為「天授聖圖」，洛水為永昌洛水，封其神為顯聖侯，加特進，禁漁釣。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the seventh month, a general amnesty was proclaimed. The "Treasure Chart" was renamed "Heaven-Bestowed Sacred Chart," the Luo River was renamed the Yongchang Luo River, its spirit was enfeoffed as Marquis of Manifest Holiness with the additional rank of special advancement, and fishing was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi in the seventh month a general amnesty was proclaimed. The "Treasure Chart" was renamed "Heaven-Bestowed Sacred Chart," the Luo River was renamed the Yongchang Luo River, its spirit was enfeoffed as Marquis of Manifest Holiness with the additional rank of special advancement, and fishing was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 改嵩山為神岳，封其神為天中王、太師、使持節、大都督。

translations.literal: Mount Song was renamed the Divine Peak, and its spirit was enfeoffed as King of the Central Heaven, Grand Preceptor, commissioner with full credentials, and grand governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Song was renamed the Divine Peak, and its spirit was enfeoffed as King of the Central Heaven, Grand Preceptor, commissioner with full credentials, and grand governor-general.

sentences.zh: 賜酺五日。

translations.literal: A five-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: A five-day drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 戊午，京師地震。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，神都地震。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu in the eighth month, Shendu was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu in the eighth month Shendu was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 丙午，博州刺史琅邪郡王沖舉兵以討亂，遣左金吾衞大將軍丘神勣拒之。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Chong, Prince of Langye commandery and prefect of Bozhou, raised troops to suppress rebellion. Qiu Shenji, grand general of the Left Golden Wild Goose Guard, was dispatched to resist him.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu Chong, Prince of Langye commandery and prefect of Bozhou, raised troops to suppress rebellion, and Qiu Shenji, grand general of the Left Golden Wild Goose Guard, was dispatched to resist him.

sentences.zh: 戊申，沖死之。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Chong died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen Chong was killed.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，越王貞舉兵于豫州以討亂。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Zhen, Prince of Yue, raised troops at Yuzhou to suppress rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu Zhen, Prince of Yue, raised troops at Yuzhou to suppress rebellion.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，曲赦博州。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Bozhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Bozhou.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，左豹韜衞大將軍麴崇裕為中軍大總管，岑長倩為後軍大總管，以拒越王貞；

translations.literal: On the day bingchen in the ninth month, Qu Chongyu, grand general of the Left Leopard Bow Guard, was made commander-in-chief of the center army, and Cen Changqian was made commander-in-chief of the rear army to resist the Prince of Yue Zhen;
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen in the ninth month Qu Chongyu, grand general of the Left Leopard Bow Guard, was appointed commander-in-chief of the center army, and Cen Changqian was appointed commander-in-chief of the rear army to resist the Prince of Yue Zhen;

sentences.zh: 張光輔為諸軍節度。

translations.literal: Zhang Guangfu was made overall commander of the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Guangfu was appointed overall commander of the armies.

sentences.zh: 削越王貞及琅邪郡王沖屬籍，改其姓為虺氏。

translations.literal: The Prince of Yue Zhen and the Prince of Langye commandery Chong were struck from the imperial clan register, and their surnames were changed to the Hui clan.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Yue Zhen and the Prince of Langye commandery Chong were struck from the imperial clan register, and their surnames were changed to the Hui clan.

sentences.zh: 貞死之。

translations.literal: Zhen died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen was killed.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，赦豫州。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Yuzhou was granted amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin Yuzhou was granted amnesty.

sentences.zh: 殺韓王元嘉、魯王靈夔、范陽郡王靄、黃國公譔、東莞郡公融及常樂公主，皆改其姓為虺氏。

translations.literal: The Prince of Han Yuanjia, the Prince of Lu Lingkui, the Prince of Fanyang commandery Ai, the Duke of Huangguo Zuan, the Duke of Dongguan commandery Rong, and the Princess of Changle were killed, and all their surnames were changed to the Hui clan.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Han Yuanjia, the Prince of Lu Lingkui, the Prince of Fanyang commandery Ai, the Duke of Huangguo Zuan, the Duke of Dongguan commandery Rong, and the Princess of Changle were killed, and all their surnames were changed to the Hui clan.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，左肅政臺御史大夫騫味道、夏官侍郎王本立同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Qian Weidao, censor-in-chief of the Left Rectification Censorate, and Wang Benli, vice minister of the summer office, were made co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao Qian Weidao, censor-in-chief of the Left Rectification Censorate, and Wang Benli, vice minister of the summer office, were appointed co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 十月辛亥，大風拔木。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the tenth month, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai in the tenth month a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 十一月辛酉，殺濟州刺史薛顗及其弟駙馬都尉紹。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou in the eleventh month, Xue Yan, prefect of Jizhou, and his younger brother Shao, commander of the imperial son-in-law guard, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou in the eleventh month Xue Yan, prefect of Jizhou, and his younger brother Shao, commander of the imperial son-in-law guard, were killed.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙酉，殺霍王元軌、江都郡王緒及殿中監裴承光。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou in the twelfth month, the Prince of Huo Yuankui, the Prince of Jiangdu commandery Xu, and Palace Supervisor Pei Chengguang were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou in the twelfth month the Prince of Huo Yuankui, the Prince of Jiangdu commandery Xu, and Palace Supervisor Pei Chengguang were killed.

sentences.zh: 大殺唐宗室，流其幼者于嶺南。

translations.literal: Many members of the Tang imperial clan were killed, and the young among them were exiled to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: Many members of the Tang imperial clan were killed, and the young among them were exiled to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 己亥，殺騫味道。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Qian Weidao was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai Qian Weidao was killed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，拜洛受圖。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, the chart was received with obeisance at the Luo River.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou the chart was received with obeisance at the Luo River.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，改明堂為萬象神宮，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the Bright Hall was renamed the Palace of Myriad Forms and the Divine Palace, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai the Bright Hall was renamed the Palace of Myriad Forms and the Divine Palace, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 永昌元年永昌元年正月乙卯，享于萬象神宮，大赦，改元，賜酺七日。

translations.literal: On the day yimao in the first month of the first year of Yongchang, sacrifices were offered at the Palace of Myriad Forms and the Divine Palace. A general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, and a seven-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao in the first month of the first year of Yongchang sacrifices were offered at the Palace of Myriad Forms and the Divine Palace. A general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, and a seven-day drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，舒王元名為司徒。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Yuanming, Prince of Shu, was made minister of education.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi Yuanming, Prince of Shu, was appointed minister of education.

sentences.zh: 戊午，布政于萬象神宮，頒九條以訓百官。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, government was proclaimed at the Palace of Myriad Forms and the Divine Palace, and nine injunctions were issued to instruct the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu government was proclaimed at the Palace of Myriad Forms and the Divine Palace, and nine injunctions were issued to instruct the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 己未，朗州雌雞化為雄。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, a hen in Langzhou transformed into a rooster.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei a hen in Langzhou transformed into a rooster.

sentences.zh: 二月丁酉，尊考太師魏忠孝王曰周忠孝太皇。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou in the second month, the deceased father, Grand Preceptor and Prince of Wei Zhongxiao, was honored as Grand Imperial Ancestor Zhongxiao of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou in the second month the deceased father, Grand Preceptor and Prince of Wei Zhongxiao, was honored as Grand Imperial Ancestor Zhongxiao of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 置崇先府官。

translations.literal: Officials of the Hall of Venerating the Ancestors were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Officials of the Hall of Venerating the Ancestors were appointed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，追謚妣楊氏曰周忠孝太后；

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the deceased mother, Lady Yang, was posthumously given the title Empress Dowager Zhongxiao of Zhou;
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu the deceased mother, Lady Yang, was posthumously given the title Empress Dowager Zhongxiao of Zhou;

sentences.zh: 太原郡王曰周安成王，妃趙氏為王妃；

translations.literal: the Prince of Taiyuan commandery was titled Prince Ancheng of Zhou, and Lady Zhao was made his consort;
translations.idiomatic: the Prince of Taiyuan commandery was titled Prince Ancheng of Zhou, and Lady Zhao was made his consort;

sentences.zh: 金城郡王曰魏義康王，妃宋氏為王妃；

translations.literal: the Prince of Jincheng commandery was titled Prince Yikang of Wei, and Lady Song was made his consort;
translations.idiomatic: the Prince of Jincheng commandery was titled Prince Yikang of Wei, and Lady Song was made his consort;

sentences.zh: 北平郡王曰趙肅恭王，妃劉氏為王妃；

translations.literal: the Prince of Beiping commandery was titled Prince Sugong of Zhao, and Lady Liu was made his consort;
translations.idiomatic: the Prince of Beiping commandery was titled Prince Sugong of Zhao, and Lady Liu was made his consort;

sentences.zh: 五代祖魯國公曰太原靖王，夫人裴氏為王妃。

translations.literal: the fifth-generation Duke of Lu was titled Prince Jing of Taiyuan, and Lady Pei was made his consort.
translations.idiomatic: the fifth-generation Duke of Lu was titled Prince Jing of Taiyuan, and Lady Pei was made his consort.

sentences.zh: 三月甲子，張光輔守納言。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi in the third month, Zhang Guangfu served as acting chancellery director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi in the third month Zhang Guangfu served as acting chancellery director.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，天官尚書武承嗣為納言，張光輔守內史。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Wu Chengsi, minister of the heaven office, was made chancellery director, and Zhang Guangfu served as acting secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou Wu Chengsi, minister of the heaven office, was appointed chancellery director, and Zhang Guangfu served as acting secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 四月甲辰，殺汝南郡王瑋、鄱陽郡公諲、廣漢郡公謐、汶山郡公蓁、零陵郡王俊、廣都郡公璹，徙其家于巂州。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen in the fourth month, the Prince of Runan commandery Wei, the Duke of Poyang commandery Shen, the Duke of Guanghan commandery Mi, the Duke of Wenshan commandery Zhen, the Duke of Lingling commandery Jun, and the Duke of Guangdu commandery Shu were killed, and their families were relocated to Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen in the fourth month the Prince of Runan commandery Wei, the Duke of Poyang commandery Shen, the Duke of Guanghan commandery Mi, the Duke of Wenshan commandery Zhen, the Duke of Lingling commandery Jun, and the Duke of Guangdu commandery Shu were killed, and their families were relocated to Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 己酉，殺天官侍郎鄧玄挺。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, Deng Xuanting, vice minister of the heaven office, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou Deng Xuanting, vice minister of the heaven office, was killed.

sentences.zh: 五月丙辰，韋待價及吐蕃戰于寅識迦河，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen in the fifth month, Wei Daigu fought the Tibetans at the Yanshijia River and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen in the fifth month Wei Daigu fought the Tibetans at the Yanshijia River and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 己巳，白馬寺僧薛懷義為新平道行軍大總管，以擊突厥。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the monk Xue Huaiyi of White Horse Temple was made campaign commander-in-chief of the Xinping Route to attack the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi the monk Xue Huaiyi of White Horse Temple was appointed campaign commander-in-chief of the Xinping Route to attack the Turks.

sentences.zh: 七月丁巳，流紀王慎于巴州，改其姓為虺氏。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the seventh month, Shen, Prince of Ji, was exiled to Bazhou, and his surname was changed to the Hui clan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi in the seventh month Shen, Prince of Ji, was exiled to Bazhou, and his surname was changed to the Hui clan.

sentences.zh: 丙子，流韋待價于繡州，殺閻溫古。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Wei Daigu was exiled to Xiuzhou, and Yan Wengu was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi Wei Daigu was exiled to Xiuzhou, and Yan Wengu was killed.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，王本立同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Wang Benli was made associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin Wang Benli was appointed associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，薛懷義為新平道中軍大總管，以擊突厥。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei in the eighth month, Xue Huaiyi was made commander-in-chief of the center army on the Xinping Route to attack the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei in the eighth month Xue Huaiyi was appointed commander-in-chief of the center army on the Xinping Route to attack the Turks.

sentences.zh: 甲申，殺張光輔、洛州司馬弓嗣業、洛陽令弓嗣明、陝州參軍弓嗣古、流人徐敬真。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, Zhang Guangfu, Gong Siye, military aide of Luozhou, Gong Siming, magistrate of Luoyang, Gong Sigu, staff officer of Shaanzhou, and the exile Xu Jingzhen were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen Zhang Guangfu, Gong Siye, military aide of Luozhou, Gong Siming, magistrate of Luoyang, Gong Sigu, staff officer of Shaanzhou, and the exile Xu Jingzhen were killed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，松州雌雞化為雄。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, a hen in Songzhou transformed into a rooster.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei a hen in Songzhou transformed into a rooster.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，殺陝州刺史郭正一。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Guo Zhengyi, prefect of Shaanzhou, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou Guo Zhengyi, prefect of Shaanzhou, was killed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，殺相州刺史弓志元、蒲州刺史弓彭祖、尚方監王令基。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Gong Zhiyuan, prefect of Xiangzhou, Gong Pengzu, prefect of Puzhou, and Wang Lingji, director of the imperial workshops, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei Gong Zhiyuan, prefect of Xiangzhou, Gong Pengzu, prefect of Puzhou, and Wang Lingji, director of the imperial workshops, were killed.

sentences.zh: 九月庚戌，殺恆山郡王承乾之子厥。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu in the ninth month, Jue, son of the Prince of Hengshan commandery Chengqian, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu in the ninth month Jue, son of the Prince of Hengshan commandery Chengqian, was killed.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲午，殺魏玄同、夏官侍郎崔詧。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu in the intercalary month, Wei Xuantong and Cui Zan, vice minister of the summer office, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu in the intercalary month Wei Xuantong and Cui Zan, vice minister of the summer office, were killed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，殺彭州長史劉易從。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Liu Yicong, chief administrator of Pengzhou, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen Liu Yicong, chief administrator of Pengzhou, was killed.

sentences.zh: 十月癸丑，殺涼州都督李光誼。

translations.literal: On the day guichou in the tenth month, Li Guangyi, military governor of Liangzhou, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou in the tenth month Li Guangyi, military governor of Liangzhou, was killed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，殺陝州刺史劉延景。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Liu Yanjing, prefect of Shaanzhou, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi Liu Yanjing, prefect of Shaanzhou, was killed.

sentences.zh: 戊午，殺右武威衞大將軍黑齒常之、右鷹揚衞將軍趙懷節。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Heichi Changzhi, grand general of the Right Martial Prestige Guard, and Zhao Huaijie, general of the Right Eagle-raising Guard, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu Heichi Changzhi, grand general of the Right Martial Prestige Guard, and Zhao Huaijie, general of the Right Eagle-raising Guard, were killed.

sentences.zh: 己未，殺嗣鄭王璥。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, Jin, Prince of Zheng, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei Jin, Prince of Zheng, was killed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，春官尚書范履冰、鳳閣侍郎邢文偉同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Fan Lubing, minister of the spring office, and Xing Wenwei, secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion, were made co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao Fan Lubing, minister of the spring office, and Xing Wenwei, secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion, were appointed co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 天授元年天授元年正月庚辰，大赦，改元曰載初，以十一月為正月，十二月為臘月，來歲正月為一月。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen in the first month of the first year of Tianshou, a general amnesty was proclaimed. The era name was changed to Zaichu. The eleventh month was made the first month, the twelfth month was made the twelfth month of the year, and the first month of the coming year was made the first month.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen in the first month of the first year of Tianshou a general amnesty was proclaimed. The era name was changed to Zaichu. The eleventh month was made the first month, the twelfth month was made the twelfth month of the year, and the first month of the coming year was made the first month.

sentences.zh: 以周、漢之後為二王後，封舜、禹、湯之裔為三恪，周、隋同列國，封其嗣。

translations.literal: Descendants of Zhou and Han were made the two honored successors, descendants of Shun, Yu, and Tang were enfeoffed as the three reverent ones, Zhou and Sui were ranked as feudal states, and their heirs were enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of Zhou and Han were made the two honored successors, descendants of Shun, Yu, and Tang were enfeoffed as the three reverent ones, Zhou and Sui were ranked as feudal states, and their heirs were enfeoffed.

sentences.zh: 乙未，除唐宗室屬籍。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the Tang imperial clan register was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei the Tang imperial clan register was abolished.

sentences.zh: 臘月丙寅，殺劉齊賢。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin in the twelfth month, Liu Qixian was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin in the twelfth month Liu Qixian was killed.

sentences.zh: 一月戊子，王本立罷。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi in the first month, Wang Benli was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi in the first month Wang Benli was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 邢文偉為內史，岑長倩、武承嗣同鳳閣鸞臺三品，鳳閣侍郎武攸寧為納言。

translations.literal: Xing Wenwei was made secretariat director. Cen Changqian and Wu Chengsi were made associates of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank. Wu Youning, secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion, was made chancellery director.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Wenwei was appointed secretariat director. Cen Changqian and Wu Chengsi were appointed associates of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank. Wu Youning, secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion, was appointed chancellery director.

sentences.zh: 甲午，流韋方質于儋州。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Wei Fangzhi was exiled to Danzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu Wei Fangzhi was exiled to Danzhou.

sentences.zh: 二月丁卯，殺地官尚書王本立。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao in the second month, Wang Benli, minister of the earth office, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao in the second month Wang Benli, minister of the earth office, was killed.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，以旱減膳。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou in the third month, because of drought the imperial diet was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou in the third month, because of drought, the imperial diet was reduced.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，蘇良嗣薨。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Su Liangsi died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai Su Liangsi died.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，殺范履冰。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi in the fifth month, Fan Lubing was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi in the fifth month Fan Lubing was killed.

sentences.zh: 己亥，殺梁郡公孝逸。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Xiaoyi, Duke of Liang commandery, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai Xiaoyi, Duke of Liang commandery, was killed.

sentences.zh: 六月戊申，殺汴州刺史柳明肅。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the sixth month, Liu Mingsu, prefect of Bianzhou, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen in the sixth month Liu Mingsu, prefect of Bianzhou, was killed.

sentences.zh: 七月辛巳，流舒王元名于和州。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi in the seventh month, Yuanming, Prince of Shu, was exiled to Hezhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi in the seventh month Yuanming, Prince of Shu, was exiled to Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 頒大雲經于天下。

translations.literal: The Great Cloud Sutra was promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Cloud Sutra was promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬午，殺豫章郡王亶。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Dan, Prince of Yuzhang commandery, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu Dan, Prince of Yuzhang commandery, was killed.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，殺澤王上金、許王素節。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Shangjin, Prince of Ze, and Sujie, Prince of Xu, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai Shangjin, Prince of Ze, and Sujie, Prince of Xu, were killed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，赦永昌縣。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Yongchang county was granted amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu Yongchang county was granted amnesty.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，殺太常丞蘇踐言。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Su Jianyan, assistant director of the court of imperial sacrifices, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao Su Jianyan, assistant director of the court of imperial sacrifices, was killed.

sentences.zh: 八月辛亥，殺許王素節之子璟、曾江縣令白令言。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the eighth month, Jing, son of the Prince of Xu Sujie, and Bai Lingyan, former magistrate of Zengjiang county, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai in the eighth month Jing, son of the Prince of Xu Sujie, and Bai Lingyan, former magistrate of Zengjiang county, were killed.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，殺裴居道。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Pei Judao was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin Pei Judao was killed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，殺將軍阿史那惠、右司郎中喬知之。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, General Ashina Hui and Qiao Zhizhi, director of the right bureau, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu General Ashina Hui and Qiao Zhizhi, director of the right bureau, were killed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，殺尚書右丞張行廉、太州刺史杜儒童。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Zhang Xinglian, vice director of the right department of the ministry of revenue, and Du Rutong, prefect of Taizhou, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai Zhang Xinglian, vice director of the right department of the ministry of revenue, and Du Rutong, prefect of Taizhou, were killed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，殺流人張楚金。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the exile Zhang Chujin was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi the exile Zhang Chujin was killed.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，殺流人元萬頃、苗神客。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the exiles Yuan Wanqing and Miao Shenke were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen the exiles Yuan Wanqing and Miao Shenke were killed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，殺南安郡王潁、鄅國公昭及諸宗室李直、李敞、李然、李勳、李策、李越、李黯、李玄、李英、李志業、李知言、李玄貞。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Ying, Prince of Nan'an commandery, Zhao, Duke of Yugu, and the imperial clansmen Li Zhi, Li Chang, Li Ran, Li Xun, Li Ce, Li Yue, Li An, Li Xuan, Li Ying, Li Zhiye, Li Zhiyan, and Li Xuanzhen were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei Ying, Prince of Nan'an commandery, Zhao, Duke of Yugu, and the imperial clansmen Li Zhi, Li Chang, Li Ran, Li Xun, Li Ce, Li Yue, Li An, Li Xuan, Li Ying, Li Zhiye, Li Zhiyan, and Li Xuanzhen were killed.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，殺鉅鹿郡公晃、麟臺郎裴望及其弟司膳丞璉。

translations.literal: On the day yihai in the ninth month, Huang, Duke of Julu commandery, Pei Wang, secretary of the Forest Terrace, and his younger brother Lian, assistant director of the imperial kitchen, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai in the ninth month Huang, Duke of Julu commandery, Pei Wang, secretary of the Forest Terrace, and his younger brother Lian, assistant director of the imperial kitchen, were killed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，改國號周。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the dynastic name was changed to Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu the dynastic name was changed to Zhou.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元，賜酺七日。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, and a seven-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, and a seven-day drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，加尊號曰聖神皇帝，降皇帝為皇嗣，賜姓武氏，皇太子為皇孫。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, the honorific title Holy Divine Emperor was added. The emperor was demoted to imperial heir, given the surname Wu, and the crown prince was made imperial grandson.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou the honorific title Holy Divine Emperor was added. The emperor was demoted to imperial heir, given the surname Wu, and the crown prince was made imperial grandson.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，立武氏七廟于神都。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the seven ancestral temples of the Wu clan were established at Shendu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu the seven ancestral temples of the Wu clan were established at Shendu.

sentences.zh: 追尊周文王曰始祖文皇帝，妣姒氏曰文定皇后；

translations.literal: King Wen of Zhou was posthumously honored as Founding Ancestor Emperor Wen, and his mother Lady Si was titled Empress Wending;
translations.idiomatic: King Wen of Zhou was posthumously honored as Founding Ancestor Emperor Wen, and his mother Lady Si was titled Empress Wending;

sentences.zh: 四十代祖平王少子武曰睿祖康皇帝，妣姜氏曰康惠皇后；

translations.literal: Wu, younger son of King Ping of the fortieth generation, was titled Sagacious Ancestor Emperor Kang, and his mother Lady Jiang was titled Empress Kanghui;
translations.idiomatic: Wu, younger son of King Ping of the fortieth generation, was titled Sagacious Ancestor Emperor Kang, and his mother Lady Jiang was titled Empress Kanghui;

sentences.zh: 太原靖王曰嚴祖成皇帝，妣曰成莊皇后；

translations.literal: the Prince Jing of Taiyuan was titled Stern Ancestor Emperor Cheng, and his mother was titled Empress Chengzhuang;
translations.idiomatic: the Prince Jing of Taiyuan was titled Stern Ancestor Emperor Cheng, and his mother was titled Empress Chengzhuang;

sentences.zh: 趙肅恭王曰肅祖章敬皇帝，妣曰章敬皇后；

translations.literal: the Prince Sugong of Zhao was titled Reverent Ancestor Emperor Zhangjing, and his mother was titled Empress Zhangjing;
translations.idiomatic: the Prince Sugong of Zhao was titled Reverent Ancestor Emperor Zhangjing, and his mother was titled Empress Zhangjing;

sentences.zh: 魏義康王曰烈祖昭安皇帝，妣曰昭安皇后；

translations.literal: the Prince Yikang of Wei was titled Illustrious Ancestor Emperor Zhao'an, and his mother was titled Empress Zhao'an;
translations.idiomatic: the Prince Yikang of Wei was titled Illustrious Ancestor Emperor Zhao'an, and his mother was titled Empress Zhao'an;

sentences.zh: 周安成王曰顯祖文穆皇帝，妣曰文穆皇后；

translations.literal: the Prince Ancheng of Zhou was titled Manifest Ancestor Emperor Wenmu, and his mother was titled Empress Wenmu;
translations.idiomatic: the Prince Ancheng of Zhou was titled Manifest Ancestor Emperor Wenmu, and his mother was titled Empress Wenmu;

sentences.zh: 忠孝太皇曰太祖孝明高皇帝，妣曰孝明高皇后。

translations.literal: the Grand Imperial Ancestor Zhongxiao was titled Great Ancestor Emperor Xiaoming Gao, and his mother was titled Empress Xiaoming Gao.
translations.idiomatic: the Grand Imperial Ancestor Zhongxiao was titled Great Ancestor Emperor Xiaoming Gao, and his mother was titled Empress Xiaoming Gao.

sentences.zh: 追封伯父及兄弟之子為王，堂兄為郡王，諸姑姊為長公主，堂姊妹為郡主。

translations.literal: Paternal uncles and sons of brothers were posthumously enfeoffed as princes, cousins as commandery princes, paternal aunts as grand princesses, and female cousins as commandery princesses.
translations.idiomatic: Paternal uncles and sons of brothers were posthumously enfeoffed as princes, cousins as commandery princes, paternal aunts as grand princesses, and female cousins as commandery princesses.

sentences.zh: 司賓卿史務滋守納言，鳳閣侍郎宗秦客檢校內史，給事中傅游藝為鸞臺侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Shi Wuzi, director of the office of guests, served as acting chancellery director. Zong Qinke, secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion, served as supervisory secretariat director. Fu Youyi, palace attendant, was made secretary of the Luan Terrace and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Wuzi, director of the office of guests, served as acting chancellery director. Zong Qinke, secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion, served as supervisory secretariat director. Fu Youyi, palace attendant, was appointed secretary of the Luan Terrace and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 十月丁巳，給復幷州武興縣百姓，子孫相承如漢豐、沛。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi in the tenth month, corvée and tax levies for the people of Wuxing county in Bingzhou were remitted in perpetuity, to be inherited by their descendants as at Han Feng and Pei.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi in the tenth month corvée and tax levies for the people of Wuxing county in Bingzhou were remitted in perpetuity, to be inherited by their descendants as at Han Feng and Pei.

sentences.zh: 甲子，貶宗秦客為遵化尉。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Zong Qinke was demoted to commandant of Dunhua.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi Zong Qinke was demoted to commandant of Dunhua.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，殺流人韋方質。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the exile Wei Fangzhi was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao the exile Wei Fangzhi was killed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，殺許王素節之子瑛、琪、琬、瓚、瑒、瑗、琛、唐臣。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Ying, Qi, Wan, Zan, Yang, Yuan, Chen, and Tangchen, sons of the Prince of Xu Sujie, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi Ying, Qi, Wan, Zan, Yang, Yuan, Chen, and Tangchen, sons of the Prince of Xu Sujie, were killed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，貶邢文偉為珍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Xing Wenwei was demoted to prefect of Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei Xing Wenwei was demoted to prefect of Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 置大雲寺。

translations.literal: The Great Cloud Temple was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Cloud Temple was established.

sentences.zh: 封周公為褒德王，孔子為隆道公。

translations.literal: The Duke of Zhou was enfeoffed as Prince of Baode, and Confucius as Duke of Longdao.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Zhou was enfeoffed as Prince of Baode, and Confucius as Duke of Longdao.

sentences.zh: 改唐太廟為享德廟，以武氏七廟為太廟。

translations.literal: The Tang ancestral temple was renamed the Hall of Honoring Virtue, and the seven temples of the Wu clan were made the imperial ancestral temple.
translations.idiomatic: The Tang ancestral temple was renamed the Hall of Honoring Virtue, and the seven temples of the Wu clan were made the imperial ancestral temple.

sentences.zh: 天授二年二年正月甲戌，改置社稷，旗幟尚赤。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the first month of the second year of Tianshou, the altars of soil and grain were reestablished, and banners and flags honored red.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu in the first month of the second year of Tianshou the altars of soil and grain were reestablished, and banners and flags honored red.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，殺雅州刺史劉行實及其弟渠州刺史行瑜、尚衣奉御行感、兄子左鷹揚衞將軍虔通。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Liu Xingshi, prefect of Yazhou, his younger brother Xingyu, prefect of Quzhou, Xinggan, director of imperial robes, and his nephew's son Qiantong, general of the Left Eagle-raising Guard, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin Liu Xingshi, prefect of Yazhou, his younger brother Xingyu, prefect of Quzhou, Xinggan, director of imperial robes, and his nephew's son Qiantong, general of the Left Eagle-raising Guard, were killed.

sentences.zh: 戊子，武承嗣為文昌左相。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Wu Chengsi was made left chancellor of the Wenchang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi Wu Chengsi was appointed left chancellor of the Wenchang.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，賜酺。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, a drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin a drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 乙未，殺丘神勣、左豹韜衞將軍衞蒲山。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, Qiu Shenji and Wei Pushan, general of the Left Leopard Bow Guard, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei Qiu Shenji and Wei Pushan, general of the Left Leopard Bow Guard, were killed.

sentences.zh: 庚子，殺史務滋。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Shi Wuzi was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi Shi Wuzi was killed.

sentences.zh: 臘月己未，始用周臘。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei in the twelfth month, the Zhou twelfth-month observance was first adopted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei in the twelfth month the Zhou twelfth-month observance was first adopted.

sentences.zh: 四月壬寅朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day renyin in the fourth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day renyin in the fourth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丙午，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，大風折木。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the fifth month, a great wind broke trees.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai in the fifth month a great wind broke trees.

sentences.zh: 岑長倩為武威道行軍大總管，以擊吐蕃。

translations.literal: Cen Changqian was made campaign commander-in-chief of the Wuwei Route to attack the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: Cen Changqian was appointed campaign commander-in-chief of the Wuwei Route to attack the Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，左肅政臺御史大夫格輔元為地官尚書，鸞臺侍郎樂思晦，鳳閣侍郎任知古：同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu in the sixth month, Ge Fuyuan, censor-in-chief of the Left Rectification Censorate, was made minister of the earth office. Yue Sihui, secretary of the Luan Terrace, and Ren Zhigu, secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion, were made co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu in the sixth month Ge Fuyuan, censor-in-chief of the Left Rectification Censorate, was appointed minister of the earth office. Yue Sihui, secretary of the Luan Terrace, and Ren Zhigu, secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion, were appointed co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 七月庚午，徙關內七州戶以實神都。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu in the seventh month, households from seven prefectures within the passes were relocated to populate Shendu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu in the seventh month households from seven prefectures within the passes were relocated to populate Shendu.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，武攸寧罷。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the eighth month, Wu Youning was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen in the eighth month Wu Youning was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 夏官尚書歐陽通為司禮卿兼判納言事。

translations.literal: Ouyang Tong, minister of the summer office, was made director of the court of imperial ceremonies and additionally charged with chancellery director affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Ouyang Tong, minister of the summer office, was appointed director of the court of imperial ceremonies and additionally charged with chancellery director affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚申，殺右玉鈐衞大將軍張虔勗。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Zhang Qianxu, grand general of the Right Jade Seal Guard, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen Zhang Qianxu, grand general of the Right Jade Seal Guard, was killed.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，殺岐州刺史雲弘嗣。

translations.literal: On the day yihai in the ninth month, Yun Hongsi, prefect of Qizhou, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai in the ninth month Yun Hongsi, prefect of Qizhou, was killed.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，殺傅游藝。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Fu Youyi was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen Fu Youyi was killed.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，左羽林衞大將軍武攸寧守納言，冬官侍郎裴行本，洛州司馬狄仁傑為地官侍郎：同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Wu Youning, grand general of the Left Forest of Feathers Guard, served as acting chancellery director. Pei Xingben, vice minister of the winter office, and Di Renjie, military aide of Luozhou, were made vice ministers of the earth office and co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi Wu Youning, grand general of the Left Forest of Feathers Guard, served as acting chancellery director. Pei Xingben, vice minister of the winter office, and Di Renjie, military aide of Luozhou, were appointed vice ministers of the earth office and co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 十月己酉，殺岑長倩、歐陽通、格輔元。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou in the tenth month, Cen Changqian, Ouyang Tong, and Ge Fuyuan were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiyou in the tenth month Cen Changqian, Ouyang Tong, and Ge Fuyuan were killed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，殺樂思晦、左衞將軍李安靜。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Yue Sihui and Li Anjing, general of the Left Guard, were killed.
