translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu Yue Sihui and Li Anjing, general of the Left Guard, were killed.

sentences.zh: 長壽元年長壽元年一月戊辰，夏官尚書楊執柔同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen in the first month of the first year of Changshou, Yang Zhirou, minister of the summer office, was made co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen in the first month of the first year of Changshou Yang Zhirou, minister of the summer office, was appointed co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚午，貶任知古為江夏令，狄仁傑彭澤令。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, Ren Zhigu was demoted to magistrate of Jiangxia, and Di Renjie to magistrate of Pengze.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu Ren Zhigu was demoted to magistrate of Jiangxia, and Di Renjie to magistrate of Pengze.

sentences.zh: 流裴行本于嶺南。

translations.literal: Pei Xingben was exiled to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Xingben was exiled to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，殺右衞大將軍泉獻誠。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Quan Xiancheng, grand general of the Right Guard, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai Quan Xiancheng, grand general of the Right Guard, was killed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，司刑卿李遊道為冬官尚書、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Li Youdao, director of the court of judicial review, was made minister of the winter office and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen Li Youdao, director of the court of judicial review, was appointed minister of the winter office and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 二月戊午，秋官尚書袁智弘同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu in the second month, Yuan Zhihong, minister of the autumn office, was made co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu in the second month Yuan Zhihong, minister of the autumn office, was appointed co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 四月丙申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day bingshen in the fourth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day bingshen in the fourth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元如意。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and the era name was changed to Ruyi.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and the era name was changed to Ruyi.

sentences.zh: 五月，洛水溢。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Luo River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Luo River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 七月，又溢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, it overflowed again.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month it overflowed again.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌，河溢，壞河陽縣。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the eighth month, the Yellow River overflowed and destroyed Heyang county.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu in the eighth month the Yellow River overflowed and destroyed Heyang county.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，武承嗣、武攸寧、楊執柔罷；

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Wu Chengsi, Wu Youning, and Yang Zhirou were dismissed;
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin Wu Chengsi, Wu Youning, and Yang Zhirou were dismissed from office;

sentences.zh: 秋官侍郎崔元綜為鸞臺侍郎，夏官侍郎李昭德為鳳閣侍郎，權檢校天官侍郎姚璹為文昌左丞，檢校地官侍郎李元素為文昌右丞，營繕大匠王璿為夏官尚書，司賓卿崔神基：同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Cui Yuanzong, vice minister of the autumn office, was made secretary of the Luan Terrace. Li Zhaode, vice minister of the summer office, was made secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion. Yao Shuang, acting supervisory vice minister of the heaven office, was made left vice director of the Wenchang. Li Yuansu, supervisory vice minister of the earth office, was made right vice director of the Wenchang. Wang Xuan, master craftsman of construction, was made minister of the summer office. Cui Shenji, director of the office of guests, was made co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yuanzong, vice minister of the autumn office, was appointed secretary of the Luan Terrace. Li Zhaode, vice minister of the summer office, was appointed secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion. Yao Shuang, acting supervisory vice minister of the heaven office, was appointed left vice director of the Wenchang. Li Yuansu, supervisory vice minister of the earth office, was appointed right vice director of the Wenchang. Wang Xuan, master craftsman of construction, was appointed minister of the summer office. Cui Shenji, director of the office of guests, was appointed co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 九月戊戌，大霧。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu in the ninth month, there was a great fog.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu in the ninth month there was a great fog.

sentences.zh: 庚子，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 改用九月社，賜酺七日。

translations.literal: The autumn sacrifice was changed to the ninth month, and a seven-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The autumn sacrifice was changed to the ninth month, and a seven-day drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以幷州為北都。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Bingzhou was made the Northern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao Bingzhou was made the Northern Capital.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，流李遊道、袁智弘、王璿、崔神基、李元素于嶺南。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Li Youdao, Yuan Zhihong, Wang Xuan, Cui Shenji, and Li Yuansu were exiled to Lingnan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou Li Youdao, Yuan Zhihong, Wang Xuan, Cui Shenji, and Li Yuansu were exiled to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 十月丙戌，武威道行軍總管王孝傑敗吐蕃，克四鎮。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu in the tenth month, Wang Xiaojie, campaign commander of the Wuwei Route, defeated the Tibetans and captured the Four Garrisons.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu in the tenth month Wang Xiaojie, campaign commander of the Wuwei Route, defeated the Tibetans and captured the Four Garrisons.

sentences.zh: 長壽二年二年臘月癸亥，殺皇嗣妃劉氏、德妃竇氏。

translations.literal: On the day guihai in the twelfth month of the second year of Changshou, the imperial heir's consort Lady Liu and virtuous consort Lady Dou were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai in the twelfth month of the second year of Changshou the imperial heir's consort Lady Liu and virtuous consort Lady Dou were killed.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，降封皇孫成器為壽春郡王，恆王成義衡陽郡王，楚王隆基臨淄郡王，衞王隆範巴陵郡王，趙王隆業彭城郡王。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the imperial grandsons were demoted and enfeoffed: Chengi as Prince of Shouchun commandery, Chengyi, Prince of Heng, as Prince of Hengyang commandery, Longji, Prince of Chu, as Prince of Linzi commandery, Longfan, Prince of Wei, as Prince of Baling commandery, and Longye, Prince of Zhao, as Prince of Pengcheng commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao the imperial grandsons were demoted and enfeoffed: Chengi as Prince of Shouchun commandery, Chengyi, Prince of Heng, as Prince of Hengyang commandery, Longji, Prince of Chu, as Prince of Linzi commandery, Longfan, Prince of Wei, as Prince of Baling commandery, and Longye, Prince of Zhao, as Prince of Pengcheng commandery.

sentences.zh: 一月庚子，夏官侍郎婁師德同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi in the first month, Lou Shide, vice minister of the summer office, was made co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi in the first month Lou Shide, vice minister of the summer office, was appointed co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，殺尚方監裴匪躬、內常侍范雲仙。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Pei Feigong, director of the imperial workshops, and Fan Yunxian, inner palace attendant, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin Pei Feigong, director of the imperial workshops, and Fan Yunxian, inner palace attendant, were killed.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯，殺左衞員外大將軍阿史那元慶、白潤府果毅薛大信。

translations.literal: On the day jimao in the third month, Ashina Yuanqing, acting grand general of the Left Guard, and Xue Daxin, stalwart officer of Bairun prefecture, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao in the third month Ashina Yuanqing, acting grand general of the Left Guard, and Xue Daxin, stalwart officer of Bairun prefecture, were killed.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，殺冬官尚書蘇幹、相州刺史來同敏。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei in the fifth month, Su Gan, minister of the winter office, and Lai Tongmin, prefect of Xiangzhou, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei in the fifth month Su Gan, minister of the winter office, and Lai Tongmin, prefect of Xiangzhou, were killed.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，河溢棣州。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the Yellow River overflowed at Dizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou the Yellow River overflowed at Dizhou.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day dinghai in the ninth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day dinghai in the ninth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 乙未，加號金輪聖神皇帝，大赦，賜酺七日，作七寶。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the title Golden Wheel Holy Divine Emperor was added. A general amnesty was proclaimed, a seven-day drinking feast was granted, and the seven treasures were made.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei the title Golden Wheel Holy Divine Emperor was added. A general amnesty was proclaimed, a seven-day drinking feast was granted, and the seven treasures were made.

sentences.zh: 庚子，追尊烈祖昭安皇帝曰渾元昭安皇帝，顯祖文穆皇帝曰立極文穆皇帝，太祖孝明高皇帝曰無上孝明高皇帝。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Illustrious Ancestor Emperor Zhao'an was posthumously honored as Primordial Emperor Zhao'an, Manifest Ancestor Emperor Wenmu as Supreme Pole Emperor Wenmu, and Great Ancestor Emperor Xiaoming Gao as Unsurpassed Emperor Xiaoming Gao.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi Illustrious Ancestor Emperor Zhao'an was posthumously honored as Primordial Emperor Zhao'an, Manifest Ancestor Emperor Wenmu as Supreme Pole Emperor Wenmu, and Great Ancestor Emperor Xiaoming Gao as Unsurpassed Emperor Xiaoming Gao.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，姚璹罷。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Yao Shuang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou Yao Shuang was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 文昌右丞韋巨源同鳳閣鸞臺平章事，秋官侍郎陸元方為鸞臺侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事，司賓卿豆盧欽望守內史。

translations.literal: Wei Juyuan, right vice director of the Wenchang, was made co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs. Lu Yuanfang, vice minister of the autumn office, was made secretary of the Luan Terrace and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs. Dou Lu Qinwang, director of the office of guests, served as acting secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Juyuan, right vice director of the Wenchang, was appointed co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs. Lu Yuanfang, vice minister of the autumn office, was appointed secretary of the Luan Terrace and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs. Dou Lu Qinwang, director of the office of guests, served as acting secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 延載元年延載元年臘月甲戌，突厥默啜寇靈州。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the twelfth month of the first year of Yanzai, the Turk Mo-chuo raided Lingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu in the twelfth month of the first year of Yanzai the Turk Mo-chuo raided Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 右鷹揚衞大將軍李多祚敗之。

translations.literal: Li Duozuo, grand general of the Right Eagle-raising Guard, defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: Li Duozuo, grand general of the Right Eagle-raising Guard, defeated him.

sentences.zh: 一月甲午，婁師德為河源、積石、懷遠等軍營田大使。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu in the first month, Lou Shide was made commissioner for military colonies of the Heyuan, Jishi, Huaiyuan, and other armies.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu in the first month Lou Shide was appointed commissioner for military colonies of the Heyuan, Jishi, Huaiyuan, and other armies.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，薛懷義為伐逆道行軍大總管，領十八將軍以擊默啜。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu in the second month, Xue Huaiyi was made campaign commander-in-chief of the Pacification Route, leading eighteen generals to attack Mo-chuo.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu in the second month Xue Huaiyi was appointed campaign commander-in-chief of the Pacification Route, leading eighteen generals to attack Mo-chuo.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以旱慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, because of drought prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai, because of drought, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，武威道大總管王孝傑及吐蕃戰于冷泉，敗之。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Wang Xiaojie, campaign commander-in-chief of the Wuwei Route, fought the Tibetans at Lengquan and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao Wang Xiaojie, campaign commander-in-chief of the Wuwei Route, fought the Tibetans at Lengquan and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，鳳閣舍人蘇味道為鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事，李昭德檢校內史。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen in the third month, Su Weidao, secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion, was made secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs. Li Zhaode served as supervisory secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen in the third month Su Weidao, secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion, was appointed secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs. Li Zhaode served as supervisory secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 薛懷義為朔方道行軍大總管，擊默啜。

translations.literal: Xue Huaiyi was made campaign commander-in-chief of the Shuofang Route to attack Mo-chuo.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Huaiyi was appointed campaign commander-in-chief of the Shuofang Route to attack Mo-chuo.

sentences.zh: 昭德為朔方道行軍長史，味道為司馬。

translations.literal: Zhaode was made chief administrator of the Shuofang Route campaign, and Weidao was made military aide.
translations.idiomatic: Zhaode was appointed chief administrator of the Shuofang Route campaign, and Weidao was appointed military aide.

sentences.zh: 四月壬戌，常州地震。

translations.literal: On the day renxu in the fourth month, Changzhou was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu in the fourth month Changzhou was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，加號越古金輪聖神皇帝，大赦，改元，賜酺七日。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu in the fifth month, the title Transcendent Ancient Golden Wheel Holy Divine Emperor was added. A general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, and a seven-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu in the fifth month the title Transcendent Ancient Golden Wheel Holy Divine Emperor was added. A general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, and a seven-day drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 七月癸未，嵩嶽山人武什方為正諫大夫、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei in the seventh month, Wu Shifang, mountain recluse of Mount Song, was made remonstrance grand master and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei in the seventh month Wu Shifang, mountain recluse of Mount Song, was appointed remonstrance grand master and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 八月，什方罷。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Shifang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Shifang was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，王孝傑為瀚海道行軍總管。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Wang Xiaojie was made campaign commander of the Hanhai Route.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen Wang Xiaojie was appointed campaign commander of the Hanhai Route.

sentences.zh: 己巳，司賓少卿姚璹守納言；

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Yao Shuang, deputy director of the office of guests, served as acting chancellery director;
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi Yao Shuang, deputy director of the office of guests, served as acting chancellery director;

sentences.zh: 左肅政臺御史大夫楊再思為鸞臺侍郎，洛州司馬杜景佺檢校鳳閣侍郎：同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Yang Zaisi, censor-in-chief of the Left Rectification Censorate, was made secretary of the Luan Terrace. Du Jingqian, military aide of Luozhou, served as supervisory secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion. Both were made co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zaisi, censor-in-chief of the Left Rectification Censorate, was appointed secretary of the Luan Terrace. Du Jingqian, military aide of Luozhou, served as supervisory secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion. Both were appointed co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，流崔元綜于振州。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Cui Yuanzong was exiled to Zhenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin Cui Yuanzong was exiled to Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day renwu in the ninth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day renwu in the ninth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，貶李昭德為南賓尉。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Li Zhaode was demoted to commandant of Nanbin.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin Li Zhaode was demoted to commandant of Nanbin.

sentences.zh: 十月壬申，文昌右丞李元素為鳳閣侍郎，右肅政臺御史中丞周允元檢校鳳閣侍郎：同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day renshen in the tenth month, Li Yuansu, right vice director of the Wenchang, was made secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion. Zhou Yunyu, vice censor-in-chief of the Right Rectification Censorate, served as supervisory secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion. Both were made co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen in the tenth month Li Yuansu, right vice director of the Wenchang, was appointed secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion. Zhou Yunyu, vice censor-in-chief of the Right Rectification Censorate, served as supervisory secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion. Both were appointed co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 嶺南獠寇邊，容州都督張玄遇為桂、永等州經略大使。

translations.literal: Liao tribesmen in Lingnan raided the frontier. Zhang Xuanyu, military governor of Rongzhou, was made commissioner for the Gu, Yong, and other prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Liao tribesmen in Lingnan raided the frontier, and Zhang Xuanyu, military governor of Rongzhou, was appointed commissioner for the Gu, Yong, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，雨木冰。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, trees were coated with ice.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou trees were coated with ice.

sentences.zh: 天冊萬歲元年天冊萬歲元年正月辛巳，加號慈氏越古金輪聖神皇帝，改元證聖。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi in the first month of the first year of Tiancè Wansui, the title Maitreya Transcendent Ancient Golden Wheel Holy Divine Emperor was added, and the era name was changed to Zhengsheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi in the first month of the first year of Tiancè Wansui the title Maitreya Transcendent Ancient Golden Wheel Holy Divine Emperor was added, and the era name was changed to Zhengsheng.

sentences.zh: 大赦，賜酺三日。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and a three-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and a three-day drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 戊子，貶豆盧欽望為趙州刺史，韋巨源鄜州刺史，杜景佺溱州刺史，蘇味道集州刺史，陸元方綏州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Dou Lu Qinwang was demoted to prefect of Zhaozhou, Wei Juyuan to prefect of Fuzhou, Du Jingqian to prefect of Qinzhou, Su Weidao to prefect of Jizhou, and Lu Yuanfang to prefect of Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi Dou Lu Qinwang was demoted to prefect of Zhaozhou, Wei Juyuan to prefect of Fuzhou, Du Jingqian to prefect of Qinzhou, Su Weidao to prefect of Jizhou, and Lu Yuanfang to prefect of Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 丙申，萬象神宮火。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the Palace of Myriad Forms and the Divine Palace caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen the Palace of Myriad Forms and the Divine Palace caught fire.

sentences.zh: 丙午，王孝傑為朔方行軍總管，以擊突厥。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Wang Xiaojie was made campaign commander of the Shuofang Route to attack the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu Wang Xiaojie was appointed campaign commander of the Shuofang Route to attack the Turks.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day jiyou in the second month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day jiyou in the second month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 壬子，殺薛懷義。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Xue Huaiyi was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi Xue Huaiyi was killed.

sentences.zh: 甲子，罷「慈氏越古」號。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the title "Maitreya Transcendent Ancient" was removed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi the title "Maitreya Transcendent Ancient" was removed.

sentences.zh: 三月丙辰，周允元薨。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen in the third month, Zhou Yunyu died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen in the third month Zhou Yunyu died.

sentences.zh: 四月戊寅，建大周萬國頌德天樞。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the fourth month, the Great Zhou Celestial Axis for Praising Virtue of All Nations was erected.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin in the fourth month the Great Zhou Celestial Axis for Praising Virtue of All Nations was erected.

sentences.zh: 七月辛酉，吐蕃寇臨洮，王孝傑為肅邊道行軍大總管以擊之。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou in the seventh month, the Tibetans raided Lintao. Wang Xiaojie was made campaign commander-in-chief of the Subjugating the Frontier Route to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou in the seventh month the Tibetans raided Lintao, and Wang Xiaojie was appointed campaign commander-in-chief of the Subjugating the Frontier Route to attack them.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，祀南郊。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the ninth month, sacrifices were offered at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin in the ninth month sacrifices were offered at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 加號天冊金輪大聖皇帝。

translations.literal: The title Tiancè Golden Wheel Great Sage Emperor was added.
translations.idiomatic: The title Tiancè Golden Wheel Great Sage Emperor was added.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元，賜酺九日。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, and a nine-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, and a nine-day drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 以崇先廟為崇尊廟。

translations.literal: The Hall of Venerating the Ancestors was renamed the Hall of Supreme Veneration.
translations.idiomatic: The Hall of Venerating the Ancestors was renamed the Hall of Supreme Veneration.

sentences.zh: 萬歲通天元年萬歲通天元年臘月甲戌，如神岳。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the twelfth month of the first year of Wansui Tongtian, the emperor proceeded to the Divine Peak.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu in the twelfth month of the first year of Wansui Tongtian the emperor proceeded to the Divine Peak.

sentences.zh: 甲申，封于神岳。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the feng sacrifice was performed at the Divine Peak.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen the feng sacrifice was performed at the Divine Peak.

sentences.zh: 改元曰萬歲登封。

translations.literal: The era name was changed to Wansui Dengfeng.
translations.idiomatic: The era name was changed to Wansui Dengfeng.

sentences.zh: 大赦，免今歲租稅，賜酺十日。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed, this year's land tax and levies were remitted, and a ten-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, this year's land tax and levies were remitted, and a ten-day drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，禪于少室山。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the shan sacrifice was performed at Mount Shaoshi.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai the shan sacrifice was performed at Mount Shaoshi.

sentences.zh: 己丑，給復洛州二年，登封、告成縣三年。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, corvée and tax levies for Luozhou were remitted for two years, and for Dengfeng and Gaocheng counties for three years.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou corvée and tax levies for Luozhou were remitted for two years, and for Dengfeng and Gaocheng counties for three years.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，復于神都。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the emperor returned to Shendu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi the emperor returned to Shendu.

sentences.zh: 一月甲寅，婁師德為肅邊道行軍副總管，以擊吐蕃。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the first month, Lou Shide was made deputy campaign commander-in-chief of the Subjugating the Frontier Route to attack the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin in the first month Lou Shide was appointed deputy campaign commander-in-chief of the Subjugating the Frontier Route to attack the Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 己巳，改崇尊廟為太廟。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the Hall of Supreme Veneration was renamed the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi the Hall of Supreme Veneration was renamed the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，尊神岳天中王為神岳天中黃帝，天靈妃為天中黃后。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi in the second month, the King of the Central Heaven of the Divine Peak was honored as Yellow Emperor of the Central Heaven of the Divine Peak, and the Celestial Spirit Consort was honored as Yellow Empress of the Central Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi in the second month the King of the Central Heaven of the Divine Peak was honored as Yellow Emperor of the Central Heaven of the Divine Peak, and the Celestial Spirit Consort was honored as Yellow Empress of the Central Heaven.

sentences.zh: 三月壬寅，王孝傑、婁師德及吐蕃戰于素羅汗山，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day renyin in the third month, Wang Xiaojie and Lou Shide fought the Tibetans at Mount Suluohan and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin in the third month Wang Xiaojie and Lou Shide fought the Tibetans at Mount Suluohan and were defeated.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，復作明堂，改曰通天宮。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, the Bright Hall was rebuilt and renamed the Palace of Universal Penetration.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi the Bright Hall was rebuilt and renamed the Palace of Universal Penetration.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元，賜酺七日。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, and a seven-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, and a seven-day drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 四月癸酉，檢校夏官侍郎孫元亨同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou in the fourth month, Sun Yuanheng, supervisory vice minister of the summer office, was made co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou in the fourth month Sun Yuanheng, supervisory vice minister of the summer office, was appointed co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 庚子，貶婁師德為原州都督府司馬。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Lou Shide was demoted to military aide of the military governor's headquarters at Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi Lou Shide was demoted to military aide of the military governor's headquarters at Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子，契丹首領松漠都督李盡忠、歸誠州刺史孫萬榮陷營州，殺都督趙文翽。

translations.literal: On the day renzi in the fifth month, Li Jinzhong, Khitan leader and military governor of Songmo, and Sun Wanrong, prefect of Guicheng, captured Yingzhou and killed Military Governor Zhao Wenbi.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi in the fifth month Li Jinzhong, Khitan leader and military governor of Songmo, and Sun Wanrong, prefect of Guicheng, captured Yingzhou and killed Military Governor Zhao Wenbi.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，左鷹揚衞將軍曹仁師、右金吾衞大將軍張玄遇、左威衞大將軍李多祚、司農少卿麻仁節等擊之。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Cao Renshi, general of the Left Eagle-raising Guard, Zhang Xuanyu, grand general of the Right Golden Wild Goose Guard, Li Duozuo, grand general of the Left Martial Prestige Guard, Ma Renjie, deputy minister of the court of imperial granaries, and others attacked them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou Cao Renshi, general of the Left Eagle-raising Guard, Zhang Xuanyu, grand general of the Right Golden Wild Goose Guard, Li Duozuo, grand general of the Left Martial Prestige Guard, Ma Renjie, deputy minister of the court of imperial granaries, and others attacked them.

sentences.zh: 七月辛亥，春官尚書武三思為榆關道安撫大使，納言姚璹為副，以備契丹。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the seventh month, Wu Sansi, minister of the spring office, was made pacification commissioner of the Yuguan Route, with Yao Shuang, chancellery director, as his deputy, to guard against the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai in the seventh month Wu Sansi, minister of the spring office, was appointed pacification commissioner of the Yuguan Route, with Yao Shuang, chancellery director, as his deputy, to guard against the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 八月丁酉，張玄遇、曹仁師、麻仁節等及契丹戰于黃麞谷，敗績，執玄遇、仁節。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou in the eighth month, Zhang Xuanyu, Cao Renshi, Ma Renjie, and others fought the Khitan at Huangzhang Valley and were defeated. Xuanyu and Renjie were captured.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou in the eighth month Zhang Xuanyu, Cao Renshi, Ma Renjie, and others fought the Khitan at Huangzhang Valley and were defeated. Xuanyu and Renjie were captured.

sentences.zh: 九月庚子，同州刺史武攸宜為清邊道行軍大總管，以擊契丹。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi in the ninth month, Wu Youyi, prefect of Tongzhou, was made campaign commander-in-chief of the Clearing the Frontier Route to attack the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi in the ninth month Wu Youyi, prefect of Tongzhou, was appointed campaign commander-in-chief of the Clearing the Frontier Route to attack the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，吐蕃寇涼州，都督許欽明死之。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, the Tibetans raided Liangzhou, and Military Governor Xu Qinming was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingsi the Tibetans raided Liangzhou, and Military Governor Xu Qinming was killed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，幷州長史王方慶為鸞臺侍郎，殿中監李道廣：同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Wang Fangqing, chief administrator of Bingzhou, was made secretary of the Luan Terrace. Li Daoguang, palace supervisor, was made co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen Wang Fangqing, chief administrator of Bingzhou, was appointed secretary of the Luan Terrace. Li Daoguang, palace supervisor, was appointed co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 十月辛卯，契丹寇冀州，刺史陸寶積死之。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao in the tenth month, the Khitan raided Jizhou, and Prefect Lu Baoji was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao in the tenth month the Khitan raided Jizhou, and Prefect Lu Baoji was killed.

sentences.zh: 甲午，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 神功元年神功元年正月壬戌，殺李元素、孫元亨、洛州錄事參軍綦連耀、箕州刺史劉思禮、知天官侍郎事石抱忠劉奇、給事中周譒、鳳閣舍人王勮、前涇州刺史王勔、太子司議郎路敬淳、司門員外郎劉順之、右司員外郎宇文全志、來庭縣主簿柳璆。

translations.literal: On the day renxu in the first month of the first year of Shengong, Li Yuansu, Sun Yuanheng, Qi Lianyao, staff officer of Luozhou, Liu Sili, prefect of Jizhou, Shi Baozhong and Liu Qi, acting vice ministers of the heaven office, Zhou Bo, palace attendant, Wang Xu, secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion, Wang Le, former prefect of Jingzhou, Lu Jingchun, secretary of the crown prince, Liu Shunzhi, outer section director of the ministry of justice, Yuwen Quanzhi, outer section director of the right bureau, and Liu Qiu, chief clerk of Laiting county, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu in the first month of the first year of Shengong Li Yuansu, Sun Yuanheng, Qi Lianyao, staff officer of Luozhou, Liu Sili, prefect of Jizhou, Shi Baozhong and Liu Qi, acting vice ministers of the heaven office, Zhou Bo, palace attendant, Wang Xu, secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion, Wang Le, former prefect of Jingzhou, Lu Jingchun, secretary of the crown prince, Liu Shunzhi, outer section director of the ministry of justice, Yuwen Quanzhi, outer section director of the right bureau, and Liu Qiu, chief clerk of Laiting county, were killed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，突厥默啜寇勝州，平狄軍副使安道買敗之。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the Turk Mo-chuo raided Shengzhou. An Daomai, deputy commissioner of the Pingdi Army, defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai the Turk Mo-chuo raided Shengzhou, and An Daomai, deputy commissioner of the Pingdi Army, defeated him.

sentences.zh: 甲子，婁師德守鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Lou Shide served as acting secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi Lou Shide served as acting secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 一月乙巳，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day yisi in the first month, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi in the first month prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 三月庚子，王孝傑及孫萬斬戰于東硤石谷，敗績，孝傑死之。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi in the third month, Wang Xiaojie fought Sun Wanzhan at East Xiashi Valley and was defeated. Xiaojie was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi in the third month Wang Xiaojie fought Sun Wanzhan at East Xiashi Valley and was defeated. Xiaojie was killed.

sentences.zh: 戊申，赦河南、北。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, amnesty was granted to the regions north and south of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen amnesty was granted to the regions north and south of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 四月戊辰，置九鼎于通天宮。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen in the fourth month, the Nine Cauldrons were placed in the Palace of Universal Penetration.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen in the fourth month the Nine Cauldrons were placed in the Palace of Universal Penetration.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，前益州大都督府長史王及善為內史。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Wang Jishan, former chief administrator of the Protector-General's headquarters at Yizhou, was made secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiyou Wang Jishan, former chief administrator of the Protector-General's headquarters at Yizhou, was appointed secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 癸未，右金吾衞大將軍武懿宗為神兵道行軍大總管，及右豹韜衞將軍何迦密以擊契丹。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Wu Yizong, grand general of the Right Golden Wild Goose Guard, was made campaign commander-in-chief of the Divine Army Route, and He Jiami, general of the Right Leopard Bow Guard, to attack the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei Wu Yizong, grand general of the Right Golden Wild Goose Guard, was appointed campaign commander-in-chief of the Divine Army Route, and He Jiami, general of the Right Leopard Bow Guard, to attack the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，婁師德為清邊道行軍副大總管，右武衞將軍沙吒忠義為清邊中道前軍總管，以擊契丹。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the fifth month, Lou Shide was made deputy campaign commander-in-chief of the Clearing the Frontier Route, and Shazha Zhongyi, general of the Right Martial Guard, was made commander of the vanguard of the center route of the Clearing the Frontier to attack the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao in the fifth month Lou Shide was appointed deputy campaign commander-in-chief of the Clearing the Frontier Route, and Shazha Zhongyi, general of the Right Martial Guard, was appointed commander of the vanguard of the center route of the Clearing the Frontier to attack the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯，殺監察御史李昭德、司僕少卿來俊臣。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao in the sixth month, Li Zhaode, investigating censor, and Lai Junchen, deputy minister of the court of imperial stud, were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao in the sixth month Li Zhaode, investigating censor, and Lai Junchen, deputy minister of the court of imperial stud, were killed.

sentences.zh: 己卯，尚方少監宗楚客同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Zong Chuke, deputy director of the imperial workshops, was made co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao Zong Chuke, deputy director of the imperial workshops, was appointed co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊子，特進武承嗣、春官尚書武三思同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Wu Chengsi, special advancement, and Wu Sansi, minister of the spring office, were made associates of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi Wu Chengsi, special advancement, and Wu Sansi, minister of the spring office, were appointed associates of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，婁師德安撫河北。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Lou Shide pacified Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao Lou Shide pacified Hebei.

sentences.zh: 七月丁酉，武承嗣、武三思罷。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou in the seventh month, Wu Chengsi and Wu Sansi were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou in the seventh month Wu Chengsi and Wu Sansi were dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，姚璹罷。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu in the eighth month, Yao Shuang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu in the eighth month Yao Shuang was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，大赦，改元，賜酺七日。

translations.literal: On the day renyin in the ninth month, a general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, and a seven-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin in the ninth month a general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, and a seven-day drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，婁師德守納言。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Lou Shide served as acting chancellery director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu Lou Shide served as acting chancellery director.

sentences.zh: 十月甲子，給復徇忠、立節二縣一年。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi in the tenth month, corvée and tax levies for Xunzhong and Lijie counties were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi in the tenth month corvée and tax levies for Xunzhong and Lijie counties were remitted for one year.

sentences.zh: 閏月甲寅，檢校司刑卿、幽州都督狄仁傑為鸞臺侍郎，司刑卿杜景佺為鳳閣侍郎：同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the intercalary month, Di Renjie, supervisory director of the court of judicial review and military governor of Youzhou, was made secretary of the Luan Terrace. Du Jingqian, director of the court of judicial review, was made secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion. Both were made co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin in the intercalary month Di Renjie, supervisory director of the court of judicial review and military governor of Youzhou, was appointed secretary of the Luan Terrace. Du Jingqian, director of the court of judicial review, was appointed secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion. Both were appointed co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 聖曆元年聖曆元年正月甲子，大赦，改元，賜酺九日。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi in the first month of the first year of Shengli, a general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, and a nine-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi in the first month of the first year of Shengli a general amnesty was proclaimed, the era name was changed, and a nine-day drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，宗楚客罷。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Zong Chuke was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin Zong Chuke was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，李道廣罷。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Li Daoguang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai Li Daoguang was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳，召廬陵王于房州。

translations.literal: On the day jisi in the third month, the Prince of Luling was summoned from Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jisi in the third month the Prince of Luling was summoned from Fangzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，廬陵王至自房州。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, the Prince of Luling arrived from Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi the Prince of Luling arrived from Fangzhou.

sentences.zh: 四月庚寅，赦神都及河北。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin in the fourth month, amnesty was granted to Shendu and Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin in the fourth month amnesty was granted to Shendu and Hebei.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，婁師德為隴右諸軍大使，檢校河西營田事。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Lou Shide was made commissioner of the armies of Longyou and supervisory commissioner for military colonies west of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou Lou Shide was appointed commissioner of the armies of Longyou and supervisory commissioner for military colonies west of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 五月庚午，禁屠。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu in the fifth month, slaughter was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu in the fifth month slaughter was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，大風拔木。

translations.literal: On the day yimao in the sixth month, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao in the sixth month a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 七月辛未，杜景佺罷。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei in the seventh month, Du Jingqian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei in the seventh month Du Jingqian was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 八月，突厥寇邊。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, the Turks raided the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Turks raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 戊子，左豹韜衞將軍閻知微降于突厥，寇邊。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Yan Zhiwei, general of the Left Leopard Bow Guard, surrendered to the Turks and raided the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi Yan Zhiwei, general of the Left Leopard Bow Guard, surrendered to the Turks and raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 甲午，王方慶罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Wang Fangqing was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu Wang Fangqing was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 庚子，春官尚書武三思檢校內史，狄仁傑兼納言。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Wu Sansi, minister of the spring office, served as supervisory secretariat director, and Di Renjie additionally served as chancellery director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi Wu Sansi, minister of the spring office, served as supervisory secretariat director, and Di Renjie additionally served as chancellery director.

sentences.zh: 司屬卿武重規為天兵中道大總管，沙吒忠義為天兵西道前軍總管，幽州都督張仁亶為天兵東道總管，左羽林衞大將軍李多祚、右羽林衞大將軍閻敬容為天兵西道後軍總管，以擊突厥。

translations.literal: Wu Chonggui, director of the court of imperial clansmen, was made commander-in-chief of the center route of the Celestial Army. Shazha Zhongyi was made commander of the vanguard of the western route of the Celestial Army. Zhang Renyuan, military governor of Youzhou, was made commander of the eastern route of the Celestial Army. Li Duozuo, grand general of the Left Forest of Feathers Guard, and Yan Jingrong, grand general of the Right Forest of Feathers Guard, were made commanders of the rear army of the western route of the Celestial Army, to attack the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Chonggui, director of the court of imperial clansmen, was appointed commander-in-chief of the center route of the Celestial Army. Shazha Zhongyi was appointed commander of the vanguard of the western route of the Celestial Army. Zhang Renyuan, military governor of Youzhou, was appointed commander of the eastern route of the Celestial Army. Li Duozuo, grand general of the Left Forest of Feathers Guard, and Yan Jingrong, grand general of the Right Forest of Feathers Guard, were appointed commanders of the rear army of the western route of the Celestial Army, to attack the Turks.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，突厥寇蔚州。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the Turks raided Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou the Turks raided Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，寇定州，刺史孫彥高死之。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, they raided Dingzhou, and Prefect Sun Yangao was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yimao they raided Dingzhou, and Prefect Sun Yangao was killed.

sentences.zh: 九月甲子，夏官尚書武攸寧同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi in the ninth month, Wu Youning, minister of the summer office, was made associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi in the ninth month Wu Youning, minister of the summer office, was appointed associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，突厥寇趙州，長史唐波若降于突厥，刺史高叡死之。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the Turks raided Zhaozhou. Chief Administrator Tang Boro surrendered to the Turks, and Prefect Gao Rui was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen the Turks raided Zhaozhou. Chief Administrator Tang Boro surrendered to the Turks, and Prefect Gao Rui was killed.

sentences.zh: 突厥寇相州，沙吒忠義為河北道前軍總管，將軍陽基副之，李多祚為後軍總管，大將軍富福信為奇兵總管，以禦之。

translations.literal: The Turks raided Xiangzhou. Shazha Zhongyi was made commander of the vanguard of the Hebei Route, with General Yang Ji as his deputy. Li Duozuo was made commander of the rear army. Grand General Fu Fuxin was made commander of the special force, to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: The Turks raided Xiangzhou. Shazha Zhongyi was appointed commander of the vanguard of the Hebei Route, with General Yang Ji as his deputy. Li Duozuo was appointed commander of the rear army. Grand General Fu Fuxin was appointed commander of the special force, to resist them.

sentences.zh: 壬申，立廬陵王顯為皇太子，大赦，賜酺五日。

translations.literal: On the day renshen, Xian, Prince of Luling, was established as crown prince. A general amnesty was proclaimed, and a five-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renshen Xian, Prince of Luling, was established as crown prince. A general amnesty was proclaimed, and a five-day drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，皇太子為河北道行軍元帥，以擊突厥。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, the crown prince was made campaign marshal of the Hebei Route to attack the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu the crown prince was appointed campaign marshal of the Hebei Route to attack the Turks.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，狄仁傑為河北道行軍副元帥、檢校納言。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Di Renjie was made deputy campaign marshal of the Hebei Route and supervisory chancellery director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin Di Renjie was appointed deputy campaign marshal of the Hebei Route and supervisory chancellery director.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，試天官侍郎蘇味道為鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Su Weidao, acting vice minister of the heaven office, was made secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi Su Weidao, acting vice minister of the heaven office, was appointed secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 十月癸卯，狄仁傑為河北道安撫大使。

translations.literal: On the day guimao in the tenth month, Di Renjie was made pacification commissioner of the Hebei Route.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao in the tenth month Di Renjie was appointed pacification commissioner of the Hebei Route.

sentences.zh: 夏官侍郎姚元崇、麟臺少監李嶠同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: Yao Yuanchong, vice minister of the summer office, and Li Jiao, deputy director of the Forest Terrace, were made co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yuanchong, vice minister of the summer office, and Li Jiao, deputy director of the Forest Terrace, were appointed co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 族閻知微。

translations.literal: The clan of Yan Zhiwei was exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: The clan of Yan Zhiwei was exterminated.

sentences.zh: 聖曆二年二年正月壬戌，封皇嗣旦為相王。

translations.literal: On the day renxu in the first month of the second year of Shengli, Dan, the imperial heir, was enfeoffed as Prince of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu in the first month of the second year of Shengli Dan, the imperial heir, was enfeoffed as Prince of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 臘月戊子，左肅政臺御史中丞吉頊為天官侍郎，檢校右肅政臺御史中丞魏元忠為鳳閣侍郎：同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi in the twelfth month, Ji Xu, vice censor-in-chief of the Left Rectification Censorate, was made vice minister of the heaven office. Wei Yuanzhong, supervisory vice censor-in-chief of the Right Rectification Censorate, was made secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion. Both were made co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi in the twelfth month Ji Xu, vice censor-in-chief of the Left Rectification Censorate, was appointed vice minister of the heaven office. Wei Yuanzhong, supervisory vice censor-in-chief of the Right Rectification Censorate, was appointed secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion. Both were appointed co-signatories of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賜皇太子姓武氏，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, the crown prince was given the surname Wu. A general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai the crown prince was given the surname Wu. A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 一月庚申，武攸寧罷。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen in the first month, Wu Youning was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen in the first month Wu Youning was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 二月己丑，如緱氏。

translations.literal: On the day jichou in the second month, the emperor proceeded to Gou's.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou in the second month the emperor proceeded to Gou's.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，如嵩陽。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the emperor proceeded to Songyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinmao the emperor proceeded to Songyang.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，復于神都。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the emperor returned to Shendu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou the emperor returned to Shendu.

sentences.zh: 三月甲戌，以隋、唐為二王後。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the third month, Sui and Tang were made the two honored successors.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu in the third month Sui and Tang were made the two honored successors.

sentences.zh: 婁師德為納言。

translations.literal: Lou Shide was made chancellery director.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shide was appointed chancellery director.

sentences.zh: 四月壬辰，魏元忠檢校并州大都督府長史、天兵軍大總管，婁師德副之，以備突厥。

translations.literal: On the day renchen in the fourth month, Wei Yuanzhong served as supervisory chief administrator of the Protector-General's headquarters at Bingzhou and commander-in-chief of the Celestial Army, with Lou Shide as his deputy, to guard against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen in the fourth month Wei Yuanzhong served as supervisory chief administrator of the Protector-General's headquarters at Bingzhou and commander-in-chief of the Celestial Army, with Lou Shide as his deputy, to guard against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，婁師德為隴右諸軍大使。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Lou Shide was made commissioner of the armies of Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou Lou Shide was appointed commissioner of the armies of Longyou.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 七月丙辰，神都大雨，洛水溢。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen in the seventh month, Shendu was deluged by heavy rain and the Luo River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen in the seventh month Shendu was deluged by heavy rain and the Luo River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，王及善為文昌左相、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事，太子宮尹豆盧欽望為文昌右相、同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi in the eighth month, Wang Jishan was made left chancellor of the Wenchang and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs. Dou Lu Qinwang, director of the crown prince's palace, was made right chancellor of the Wenchang and associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi in the eighth month Wang Jishan was appointed left chancellor of the Wenchang and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs. Dou Lu Qinwang, director of the crown prince's palace, was appointed right chancellor of the Wenchang and associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 楊再思罷。

translations.literal: Yang Zaisi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zaisi was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 丁未，試天官侍郎陸元方為鸞臺侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Lu Yuanfang, acting vice minister of the heaven office, was made secretary of the Luan Terrace and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei Lu Yuanfang, acting vice minister of the heaven office, was appointed secretary of the Luan Terrace and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 婁師德薨。

translations.literal: Lou Shide died.
translations.idiomatic: Lou Shide died.

sentences.zh: 戊申，武三思為內史。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Wu Sansi was made secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen Wu Sansi was appointed secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 九月乙亥，如福昌縣，曲赦。

translations.literal: On the day yihai in the ninth month, the emperor proceeded to Fuchang county and proclaimed a partial amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai in the ninth month the emperor proceeded to Fuchang county and proclaimed a partial amnesty.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，復于神都。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, the emperor returned to Shendu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin the emperor returned to Shendu.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，王及善薨。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Wang Jishan died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen Wang Jishan died.

sentences.zh: 是秋，黃河溢。

translations.literal: That autumn the Yellow River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn the Yellow River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 十月丁亥，吐蕃首領贊婆來。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the tenth month, Zanpo, Tibetan leader, came.
