translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai in the third month Chongfu, Prince of Ping'en commandery and imperial grandson, was promoted and enfeoffed as Prince of Qiao.

sentences.zh: 己亥，夏官侍郎宗楚客同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Zong Chuke, vice minister of the summer office, was made co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai Zong Chuke, vice minister of the summer office, was appointed co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 貶蘇味道為坊州刺史。

translations.literal: Su Weidao was demoted to prefect of Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Su Weidao was demoted to prefect of Fangzhou.

sentences.zh: 四月壬戌，韋安石知納言事，李嶠知內史事。

translations.literal: On the day renxu in the fourth month, Wei Anshi was charged with chancellery director affairs, and Li Jiao was charged with secretariat director affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu in the fourth month Wei Anshi was charged with chancellery director affairs, and Li Jiao was charged with secretariat director affairs.

sentences.zh: 丙子，如興泰宮，赦壽安縣，給復一年。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the emperor proceeded to the Xingtai Palace, granted amnesty to Shou'an county, and remitted corvée and tax levies for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi the emperor proceeded to the Xingtai Palace, granted amnesty to Shou'an county, and remitted corvée and tax levies for one year.

sentences.zh: 五月丁亥，大風拔木。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the fifth month, a great wind uprooted trees.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai in the fifth month a great wind uprooted trees.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，姚元之罷。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou in the sixth month, Yao Yuanzhi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou in the sixth month Yao Yuanzhi was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，天官侍郎崔玄暐為鸞臺侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, Cui Xuanwei, vice minister of the heaven office, was made secretary of the Luan Terrace and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou Cui Xuanwei, vice minister of the heaven office, was appointed secretary of the Luan Terrace and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，李嶠同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Li Jiao was made associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou Li Jiao was appointed associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 壬午，相王府長史姚元之兼知夏官尚書、同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Yao Yuanzhi, chief administrator of the Prince of Xiang's household, additionally served as minister of the summer office and associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu Yao Yuanzhi, chief administrator of the Prince of Xiang's household, additionally served as minister of the summer office and associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 七月丙戌，左肅政臺御史大夫楊再思守內史。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu in the seventh month, Yang Zaisi, censor-in-chief of the Left Rectification Censorate, served as acting secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu in the seventh month Yang Zaisi, censor-in-chief of the Left Rectification Censorate, served as acting secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 甲午，復于神都。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the emperor returned to Shendu.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu the emperor returned to Shendu.

sentences.zh: 貶宗楚客為原州都督。

translations.literal: Zong Chuke was demoted to military governor of Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zong Chuke was demoted to military governor of Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，唐休璟兼幽營二州都督、安東都護。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen in the eighth month, Tang Xiujing additionally served as military governor of You and Ying prefectures and protector-general of Andong.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen in the eighth month Tang Xiujing additionally served as military governor of You and Ying prefectures and protector-general of Andong.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，姚元之為靈武道行軍大總管。

translations.literal: On the day renzi in the ninth month, Yao Yuanzhi was made campaign commander-in-chief of the Lingwu Route.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi in the ninth month Yao Yuanzhi was appointed campaign commander-in-chief of the Lingwu Route.

sentences.zh: 十月辛酉，元之為靈武道安撫大使。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou in the tenth month, Yuanzhi was made pacification commissioner of the Lingwu Route.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou in the tenth month Yuanzhi was appointed pacification commissioner of the Lingwu Route.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，判秋官侍郎張柬之同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Zhang Jianzhi, acting vice minister of the autumn office, was made co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu Zhang Jianzhi, acting vice minister of the autumn office, was appointed co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬午，懷州長史房融為正諫大夫、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Fang Rong, chief administrator of Huaizhou, was made remonstrance grand master and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu Fang Rong, chief administrator of Huaizhou, was appointed remonstrance grand master and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁亥，天官侍郎韋承慶行鳳閣侍郎、同鳳閣鸞臺平章事。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai in the eleventh month, Wei Chengqing, vice minister of the heaven office, served as acting secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dinghai in the eleventh month Wei Chengqing, vice minister of the heaven office, served as acting secretary of the Phoenix Pavilion and co-signatory of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace affairs.

sentences.zh: 李嶠罷。

translations.literal: Li Jiao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiao was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙辰，韋嗣立罷。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen in the twelfth month, Wei Sili was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen in the twelfth month Wei Sili was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 神龍元年五年正月壬午，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day renwu in the first month of the fifth year of the first year of Shenlong, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu in the first month of the fifth year of the first year of Shenlong a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，禁屠。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, slaughter was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin slaughter was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，張柬之、崔玄暐及左羽林衞將軍敬暉、檢校左羽林衞將軍桓彥範、司刑少卿袁恕己、左羽林衞將軍李湛薛思行趙承恩、右羽林衞將軍楊元琰、左羽林衞大將軍李多祚、職方郎中崔泰之、庫部員外郎朱敬則、司刑評事冀仲甫、檢校司農少卿兼知總監翟世言、內直郎王同皎率左右羽林兵以討亂；

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Zhang Jianzhi, Cui Xuanwei, Jing Hui, general of the Left Forest of Feathers Guard, Huan Yanfan, supervisory general of the Left Forest of Feathers Guard, Yuan Shuji, deputy director of the court of judicial review, Li Zhan, Xue Sixing, Zhao Chengen, generals of the Left Forest of Feathers Guard, Yang Yuanyan, general of the Right Forest of Feathers Guard, Li Duozuo, grand general of the Left Forest of Feathers Guard, Cui Taizhi, director of the bureau of appointments, Zhu Jingze, outer section director of the ministry of revenue, Ji Zhongfu, judicial reviewer of the court of judicial review, Zhai Shiyan, supervisory deputy minister of the court of imperial granaries and acting director-general, and Wang Tongjiao, inner palace attendant, led the left and right Forest of Feathers troops to suppress rebellion;
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao Zhang Jianzhi, Cui Xuanwei, Jing Hui, general of the Left Forest of Feathers Guard, Huan Yanfan, supervisory general of the Left Forest of Feathers Guard, Yuan Shuji, deputy director of the court of judicial review, Li Zhan, Xue Sixing, Zhao Chengen, generals of the Left Forest of Feathers Guard, Yang Yuanyan, general of the Right Forest of Feathers Guard, Li Duozuo, grand general of the Left Forest of Feathers Guard, Cui Taizhi, director of the bureau of appointments, Zhu Jingze, outer section director of the ministry of revenue, Ji Zhongfu, judicial reviewer of the court of judicial review, Zhai Shiyan, supervisory deputy minister of the court of imperial granaries and acting director-general, and Wang Tongjiao, inner palace attendant, led the left and right Forest of Feathers troops to suppress rebellion;

sentences.zh: 麟臺監張易之、春官侍郎張昌宗、汴州刺史張昌期、司禮少卿張同休、通事舍人張景雄伏誅。

translations.literal: Zhang Yizhi, director of the Forest Terrace, Zhang Changzong, vice minister of the spring office, Zhang Changqi, prefect of Bianzhou, Zhang Tongxiu, deputy director of the court of imperial ceremonies, and Zhang Jingxiong, palace attendant, were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yizhi, director of the Forest Terrace, Zhang Changzong, vice minister of the spring office, Zhang Changqi, prefect of Bianzhou, Zhang Tongxiu, deputy director of the court of imperial ceremonies, and Zhang Jingxiong, palace attendant, were executed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，皇帝復于位。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, the emperor was restored to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu the emperor was restored to the throne.

sentences.zh: 丁未，徙后于上陽宮。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, the empress was moved to the Shangyang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingwei the empress was moved to the Shangyang Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊申，上后號曰則天大聖皇帝。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the empress was given the title Emperor Zetian the Great Sage.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen the empress was given the title Emperor Zetian the Great Sage.

sentences.zh: 十一月，崩，謚曰大聖則天皇后。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month she died, and was given the posthumous title Empress Zetian the Great Sage.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month she died and was given the posthumous title Empress Zetian the Great Sage.

sentences.zh: 唐隆元年，改為天后；

translations.literal: In the first year of Tanglong, it was changed to Heavenly Empress;
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tanglong the title was changed to Heavenly Empress;

sentences.zh: 景雲元年，改為大聖天后；

translations.literal: in the first year of Jingyun, it was changed to Great Sage Heavenly Empress;
translations.idiomatic: in the first year of Jingyun it was changed to Great Sage Heavenly Empress;

sentences.zh: 延和元年，改為天后聖帝，未幾，改為聖后；

translations.literal: in the first year of Yanhe, it was changed to Heavenly Empress the Sage Emperor, and soon after was changed to Sage Empress;
translations.idiomatic: in the first year of Yanhe it was changed to Heavenly Empress the Sage Emperor, and soon after was changed to Sage Empress;

sentences.zh: 開元四年，改為則天皇后；

translations.literal: in the fourth year of Kaiyuan, it was changed to Empress Zetian;
translations.idiomatic: in the fourth year of Kaiyuan it was changed to Empress Zetian;

sentences.zh: 天寶八載，加謚則天順聖皇后。

translations.literal: in the eighth year of Tianbao, the posthumous title was augmented to Empress Zetian the Shun Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: in the eighth year of Tianbao the posthumous title was augmented to Empress Zetian the Shun Sheng.

sentences.zh: 中宗中宗大和大聖大昭孝皇帝諱顯，高宗第七子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Zhongzong, Emperor Dahe Dasheng Dazhao Xia, taboo name Xian, was the seventh son of Gaozong.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Zhongzong, Emperor Dahe Dasheng Dazhao Xia, taboo name Xian, was the seventh son of Gaozong.

sentences.zh: 母曰則天順聖皇后武氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Zetian the Shun Sheng of the Wu clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Zetian the Shun Sheng of the Wu clan.

sentences.zh: 高宗崩，以皇太子即皇帝位，而皇太后臨朝稱制。

translations.literal: When Gaozong died, he ascended the throne as crown prince, and the empress dowager held court and exercised imperial authority.
translations.idiomatic: When Gaozong died he ascended the throne as crown prince, and the empress dowager held court and exercised imperial authority.

sentences.zh: 嗣聖元年正月，廢居于均州，又遷于房州。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Sisheng, he was deposed and lived in retirement at Junzhou, and was later moved to Fangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Sisheng he was deposed and lived in retirement at Junzhou, and was later moved to Fangzhou.

sentences.zh: 聖曆二年，復為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shengli, he was restored as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Shengli he was restored as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 太后老且病。

translations.literal: The empress dowager was old and ill.
translations.idiomatic: The empress dowager was old and ill.

sentences.zh: 神龍元年神龍元年正月，張柬之等以羽林兵討亂。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Shenlong, Zhang Jianzhi and others used Forest of Feathers troops to suppress rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of Shenlong Zhang Jianzhi and others used Forest of Feathers troops to suppress rebellion.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，皇太子監國，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the crown prince supervised the state. A general amnesty was proclaimed, and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen the crown prince supervised the state. A general amnesty was proclaimed, and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 丙午，復于位，大赦，賜文武官階、爵，民酺五日，免今歲租賦，給復房州三年，放宮女三千人。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, he was restored to the throne. A general amnesty was proclaimed. Civil and military officials were granted ranks and titles. The people were granted a five-day drinking feast. This year's land tax and levies were remitted. Corvée and tax levies for Fangzhou were remitted for three years. Three thousand palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu he was restored to the throne. A general amnesty was proclaimed. Civil and military officials were granted ranks and titles. The people were granted a five-day drinking feast. This year's land tax and levies were remitted. Corvée and tax levies for Fangzhou were remitted for three years. Three thousand palace women were released.

sentences.zh: 相王旦為安國相王、太尉、同鳳閣鸞臺三品。

translations.literal: Dan, Prince of Xiang, was made Prince of Xiang of the Pacifying State, grand commandant, and associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Dan, Prince of Xiang, was made Prince of Xiang of the Pacifying State, grand commandant, and associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，張柬之、袁恕己同鳳閣鸞臺三品，崔玄暐守內史，敬暉為納言，桓彥範守納言。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Zhang Jianzhi and Yuan Shuji were made associates of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank. Cui Xuanwei served as acting secretariat director. Jing Hui was made chancellery director. Huan Yanfan served as acting chancellery director.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu Zhang Jianzhi and Yuan Shuji were appointed associates of the Phoenix Pavilion and Luan Terrace of the third rank. Cui Xuanwei served as acting secretariat director. Jing Hui was appointed chancellery director. Huan Yanfan served as acting chancellery director.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，復國號唐。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin in the second month, the dynastic name Tang was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin in the second month the dynastic name Tang was restored.

sentences.zh: 貶韋承慶為高要尉，流房融于高州。

translations.literal: Wei Chengqing was demoted to commandant of Gaoyao, and Fang Rong was exiled to Gaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Chengqing was demoted to commandant of Gaoyao, and Fang Rong was exiled to Gaozhou.

sentences.zh: 楊再思同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: Yang Zaisi was made associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Zaisi was appointed associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 姚元之罷。

translations.literal: Yao Yuanzhi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Yuanzhi was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 甲子，皇后韋氏復于位，大赦，賜酺三日，復宗室死于周者官爵。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Empress Wei was restored to her position. A general amnesty was proclaimed, a three-day drinking feast was granted, and official ranks and titles were restored to imperial clansmen who had died under Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi Empress Wei was restored to her position. A general amnesty was proclaimed, a three-day drinking feast was granted, and official ranks and titles were restored to imperial clansmen who had died under Zhou.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，太子賓客武三思為司空、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Wu Sansi, guest of the crown prince, was made minister of works and associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin Wu Sansi, guest of the crown prince, was appointed minister of works and associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 貶譙王重福為濮州刺史。

translations.literal: Chongfu, Prince of Qiao, was demoted to prefect of Puzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Chongfu, Prince of Qiao, was demoted to prefect of Puzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，右散騎常侍、駙馬都尉武攸暨為司徒。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Wu Youji, right attendant cavalier and commander of the imperial son-in-law guard, was made minister of education.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao Wu Youji, right attendant cavalier and commander of the imperial son-in-law guard, was appointed minister of education.

sentences.zh: 辛未，安國相王旦罷。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Dan, Prince of Xiang of the Pacifying State, was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei Dan, Prince of Xiang of the Pacifying State, was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太子少詹事祝欽明同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Zhu Qinming, junior steward of the crown prince, was made associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu Zhu Qinming, junior steward of the crown prince, was appointed associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 韋安石罷。

translations.literal: Wei Anshi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Anshi was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 進封子義興郡王重俊為衞王，北海郡王重茂溫王。

translations.literal: The sons were promoted and enfeoffed: Chongjun, Prince of Yixing commandery, as Prince of Wei, and Chongmao, Prince of Beihai commandery, as Prince of Wen.
translations.idiomatic: The sons were promoted and enfeoffed: Chongjun, Prince of Yixing commandery, as Prince of Wei, and Chongmao, Prince of Beihai commandery, as Prince of Wen.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，武三思、武攸暨罷。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Wu Sansi and Wu Youji were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou Wu Sansi and Wu Youji were dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 三月甲申，詔文明後破家者昭洗之，還其子孫蔭。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen in the third month, an edict proclaimed the rehabilitation of those whose families had been destroyed after the Wenming era and restored hereditary privileges to their descendants.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiashen in the third month an edict proclaimed the rehabilitation of those whose families had been destroyed after the Wenming era and restored hereditary privileges to their descendants.

sentences.zh: 己丑，袁恕己守中書令。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Yuan Shuji served as acting director of the secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou Yuan Shuji served as acting director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 四月辛亥，桓彥範為侍中，袁恕己為中書令。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the fourth month, Huan Yanfan was made palace attendant, and Yuan Shuji was made director of the secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai in the fourth month Huan Yanfan was appointed palace attendant, and Yuan Shuji was appointed director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，高要尉魏元忠為衞尉卿、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Wei Yuanzhong, commandant of Gaoyao, was made director of the court of imperial guards and co-signatory of the Secretariat and Chancellery affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao Wei Yuanzhong, commandant of Gaoyao, was appointed director of the court of imperial guards and co-signatory of the Secretariat and Chancellery affairs.

sentences.zh: 辛未，敬暉為侍中。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Jing Hui was made palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei Jing Hui was appointed palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，魏元忠、崔玄暐，刑部尚書韋安石為吏部尚書，太子右庶子李懷遠為左散騎常侍，涼州都督唐休璟為輔國大將軍：同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Wei Yuanzhong and Cui Xuanwei, Wei Anshi, minister of justice, was made minister of civil office, Li Huaiyuan, right assistant to the crown prince, was made left attendant cavalier, and Tang Xiujing, military governor of Liangzhou, was made grand general for assisting the state, all as associates of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu Wei Yuanzhong and Cui Xuanwei were made associates of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank. Wei Anshi, minister of justice, was appointed minister of civil office. Li Huaiyuan, right assistant to the crown prince, was appointed left attendant cavalier. Tang Xiujing, military governor of Liangzhou, was appointed grand general for assisting the state, all as associates of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，張柬之為中書令。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Zhang Jianzhi was made director of the secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai Zhang Jianzhi was appointed director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，遷武氏神主于崇恩廟。

translations.literal: On the day renwu in the fifth month, the spirit tablets of the Wu clan were moved to the Hall of Honoring Grace.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu in the fifth month the spirit tablets of the Wu clan were moved to the Hall of Honoring Grace.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，立太廟、社稷于東都。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, the imperial ancestral temple and altars of soil and grain were established at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou the imperial ancestral temple and altars of soil and grain were established at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 戊子，復周、隋二王後。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, the two honored successors of Zhou and Sui were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi the two honored successors of Zhou and Sui were restored.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，進封兄成紀郡王千里為成王。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, the elder brother Qianli, Prince of Chengji commandery, was promoted and enfeoffed as Prince of Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen the elder brother Qianli, Prince of Chengji commandery, was promoted and enfeoffed as Prince of Cheng.

sentences.zh: 甲午，敬暉、桓彥範、張柬之、袁恕己、崔玄暐罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Jing Hui, Huan Yanfan, Zhang Jianzhi, Yuan Shuji, and Cui Xuanwei were dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu Jing Hui, Huan Yanfan, Zhang Jianzhi, Yuan Shuji, and Cui Xuanwei were dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 韋安石兼檢校中書令，魏元忠兼侍中。

translations.literal: Wei Anshi additionally served as supervisory director of the secretariat, and Wei Yuanzhong additionally served as palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Anshi additionally served as supervisory director of the secretariat, and Wei Yuanzhong additionally served as palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，唐休璟為尚書左僕射，特進豆盧欽望為尚書右僕射：同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Tang Xiujing was made left vice director of the department of state affairs, and Dou Lu Qinwang, special advancement, was made right vice director of the department of state affairs, both as associates of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen Tang Xiujing was appointed left vice director of the department of state affairs, and Dou Lu Qinwang, special advancement, was appointed right vice director of the department of state affairs, both as associates of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，左驍衞大將軍裴思諒為靈武道行軍大總管，以備突厥。

translations.literal: On the day renzi in the sixth month, Pei Silang, grand general of the Left Martial Courage Guard, was made campaign commander-in-chief of the Lingwu Route to guard against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi in the sixth month Pei Silang, grand general of the Left Martial Courage Guard, was appointed campaign commander-in-chief of the Lingwu Route to guard against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，韋安石為中書令，魏元忠為侍中，楊再思檢校中書令，豆盧欽望平章軍國重事。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, Wei Anshi was made director of the secretariat, Wei Yuanzhong was made palace attendant, Yang Zaisi served as supervisory director of the secretariat, and Dou Lu Qinwang was made co-signatory of important state and military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai Wei Anshi was appointed director of the secretariat, Wei Yuanzhong was appointed palace attendant, Yang Zaisi served as supervisory director of the secretariat, and Dou Lu Qinwang was appointed co-signatory of important state and military affairs.

sentences.zh: 七月辛巳，太子賓客韋巨源同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi in the seventh month, Wei Juyuan, guest of the crown prince, was made associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi in the seventh month Wei Juyuan, guest of the crown prince, was appointed associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，洛水溢。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the Luo River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen the Luo River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，給復河南、洛陽二縣一年。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the eighth month, corvée and tax levies for Henan and Luoyang counties were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen in the eighth month corvée and tax levies for Henan and Luoyang counties were remitted for one year.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，追冊妃趙氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Consort Zhao was posthumously enfeoffed as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu Consort Zhao was posthumously enfeoffed as empress.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，祔孝敬皇帝于東都太廟。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, Emperor Xiaojing was enshrined in the imperial ancestral temple at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yihai Emperor Xiaojing was enshrined in the imperial ancestral temple at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 皇后見于廟。

translations.literal: The empress was presented at the temple.
translations.idiomatic: The empress was presented at the temple.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，幸洛城南門，觀鬬象。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the emperor visited the south gate of Luoyang to watch elephant fights.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou the emperor visited the south gate of Luoyang to watch elephant fights.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，祀天地于明堂。

translations.literal: On the day renwu in the ninth month, Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu in the ninth month Heaven and Earth were sacrificed to at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 大赦，賜文武官勳、爵，民為父後者古爵一級，酺三日。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed. Civil and military officials were granted honors and titles. Commoners who were heads of households were granted one ancient rank. A three-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed. Civil and military officials were granted honors and titles. Commoners who were heads of households were granted one ancient rank. A three-day drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，韋巨源罷。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Wei Juyuan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi Wei Juyuan was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 十月癸亥，幸龍門。

translations.literal: On the day guihai in the tenth month, the emperor visited Longmen.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai in the tenth month the emperor visited Longmen.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，獵于新安。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, the emperor hunted at Xin'an.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou the emperor hunted at Xin'an.

sentences.zh: 辛未，魏元忠為中書令，楊再思為侍中。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Wei Yuanzhong was made director of the secretariat, and Yang Zaisi was made palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei Wei Yuanzhong was appointed director of the secretariat, and Yang Zaisi was appointed palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，上尊號曰應天皇帝，皇后曰順天皇后。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the eleventh month, the honorific title Responsive-to-Heaven Emperor was bestowed, and the empress was titled Responsive-to-Heaven Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin in the eleventh month the honorific title Responsive-to-Heaven Emperor was bestowed, and the empress was titled Responsive-to-Heaven Empress.

sentences.zh: 壬午，及皇后享于太廟，大赦，賜文武官階、勳、爵，民酺三日。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the emperor and empress offered sacrifices at the imperial ancestral temple. A general amnesty was proclaimed. Civil and military officials were granted ranks, honors, and titles. The people were granted a three-day drinking feast.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu the emperor and empress offered sacrifices at the imperial ancestral temple. A general amnesty was proclaimed. Civil and military officials were granted ranks, honors, and titles. The people were granted a three-day drinking feast.

sentences.zh: 己丑，幸洛城南門，觀潑寒胡戲。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the emperor visited the south gate of Luoyang to watch the splashing cold Hu performance.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou the emperor visited the south gate of Luoyang to watch the splashing cold Hu performance.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，皇太后崩，廢崇恩廟。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the empress dowager died, and the Hall of Honoring Grace was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin the empress dowager died, and the Hall of Honoring Grace was abolished.

sentences.zh: 神龍二年二年正月戊戌，吏部尚書李嶠同中書門下三品，中書侍郎于惟謙同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu in the first month of the second year of Shenlong, Li Jiao, minister of civil office, was made associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank. Yu Weiqian, vice director of the secretariat, was made co-signatory of the Secretariat and Chancellery affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu in the first month of the second year of Shenlong Li Jiao, minister of civil office, was appointed associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank. Yu Weiqian, vice director of the secretariat, was appointed co-signatory of the Secretariat and Chancellery affairs.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙午，公主開府置官屬。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu in the intercalary month, princesses were permitted to establish offices and appoint staff.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu in the intercalary month princesses were permitted to establish offices and appoint staff.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，禮部尚書韋巨源為刑部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei in the second month, Wei Juyuan, minister of rites, was made minister of justice and associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiwei in the second month Wei Juyuan, minister of rites, was appointed minister of justice and associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 丙申，遣十道巡察使。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, inspection commissioners for the ten circuits were dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen inspection commissioners for the ten circuits were dispatched.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，韋安石罷。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen in the third month, Wei Anshi was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen in the third month Wei Anshi was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 戶部尚書蘇瓌守侍中。

translations.literal: Su Gui, minister of revenue, served as acting palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: Su Gui, minister of revenue, served as acting palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 戊申，唐休璟罷。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Tang Xiujing was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen Tang Xiujing was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，殺光祿卿、駙馬都尉王同皎。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Wang Tongjiao, director of the court of imperial entertainments and commander of the imperial son-in-law guard, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu Wang Tongjiao, director of the court of imperial entertainments and commander of the imperial son-in-law guard, was killed.

sentences.zh: 是月，置員外官。

translations.literal: That month, supernumerary officials were established.
translations.idiomatic: That month supernumerary officials were established.

sentences.zh: 四月己丑，李懷遠罷。

translations.literal: On the day jichou in the fourth month, Li Huaiyuan was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou in the fourth month Li Huaiyuan was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 己亥，雨毛于鄮縣。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, hair rained down at Mao county.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jihai hair rained down at Mao county.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，洛水溢。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, the Luo River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou the Luo River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 五月庚申，葬則天大聖皇后。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen in the fifth month, Empress Zetian the Great Sage was buried.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen in the fifth month Empress Zetian the Great Sage was buried.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，貶敬暉為崖州司馬，桓彥範瀧州司馬，袁恕己竇州司馬，崔玄暐白州司馬，張柬之新州司馬。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the sixth month, Jing Hui was demoted to military aide of Yazhou, Huan Yanfan to military aide of Longzhou, Yuan Shuji to military aide of Douzhou, Cui Xuanwei to military aide of Baizhou, and Zhang Jianzhi to military aide of Xinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin in the sixth month Jing Hui was demoted to military aide of Yazhou, Huan Yanfan to military aide of Longzhou, Yuan Shuji to military aide of Douzhou, Cui Xuanwei to military aide of Baizhou, and Zhang Jianzhi to military aide of Xinzhou.

sentences.zh: 七月戊申，立衞王重俊為皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day wushen in the seventh month, Chongjun, Prince of Wei, was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wushen in the seventh month Chongjun, Prince of Wei, was established as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，魏元忠為尚書右僕射、兼中書令，李嶠守中書令。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Wei Yuanzhong was made right vice director of the department of state affairs and additionally director of the secretariat. Li Jiao served as acting director of the secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin Wei Yuanzhong was appointed right vice director of the department of state affairs and additionally director of the secretariat. Li Jiao served as acting director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 辛未，左散騎常侍致仕李懷遠同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Li Huaiyuan, retired left attendant cavalier, was made associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinwei Li Huaiyuan, retired left attendant cavalier, was appointed associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 流敬暉于嘉州，桓彥範于瀼州，袁恕己于環州，崔玄暐于古州，張柬之于瀧州。

translations.literal: Jing Hui was exiled to Jiazhou, Huan Yanfan to Rangzhou, Yuan Shuji to Huanzhou, Cui Xuanwei to Guzhou, and Zhang Jianzhi to Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Jing Hui was exiled to Jiazhou, Huan Yanfan to Rangzhou, Yuan Shuji to Huanzhou, Cui Xuanwei to Guzhou, and Zhang Jianzhi to Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月丙子，貶祝欽明為申州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi in the eighth month, Zhu Qinming was demoted to prefect of Shenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingzi in the eighth month Zhu Qinming was demoted to prefect of Shenzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，李懷遠薨。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu in the ninth month, Li Huaiyuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu in the ninth month Li Huaiyuan died.

sentences.zh: 十月癸巳，蘇瓌為侍中。

translations.literal: On the day guisi in the tenth month, Su Gui was made palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi in the tenth month Su Gui was appointed palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，至自東都。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, the emperor returned from the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu the emperor returned from the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙巳，大赦，賜行從官勳一轉。

translations.literal: On the day yisi in the eleventh month, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and accompanying officials were granted one rotation of honors.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi in the eleventh month a general amnesty was proclaimed, and accompanying officials were granted one rotation of honors.

sentences.zh: 十二月己卯，靈武軍大總管沙吒忠義及突厥戰于鳴沙，敗績。

translations.literal: On the day jimao in the twelfth month, Shazha Zhongyi, commander-in-chief of the Lingwu Army, fought the Turks at Mingsha and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao in the twelfth month Shazha Zhongyi, commander-in-chief of the Lingwu Army, fought the Turks at Mingsha and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以突厥寇邊、京師旱、河北水，減膳，罷土木工。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, because the Turks raided the frontier, the capital suffered drought, and Hebei was flooded, the imperial diet was reduced and construction work was halted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu, because the Turks raided the frontier, the capital suffered drought, and Hebei was flooded, the imperial diet was reduced and construction work was halted.

sentences.zh: 蘇瓌存撫河北。

translations.literal: Su Gui pacified and comforted Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: Su Gui pacified and comforted Hebei.

sentences.zh: 丙申，魏元忠為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, Wei Yuanzhong was made left vice director of the department of state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen Wei Yuanzhong was appointed left vice director of the department of state affairs.

sentences.zh: 景龍元年景龍元年正月丙辰，以旱慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen in the first month of the first year of Jinglong, because of drought prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen in the first month of the first year of Jinglong, because of drought, prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 二月丙戌，復武氏廟、陵，置令、丞、守戶如昭陵。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu in the second month, the Wu clan temples and tombs were restored, and directors, assistants, and custodial households were appointed as at Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu in the second month the Wu clan temples and tombs were restored, and directors, assistants, and custodial households were appointed as at Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 甲午，褒德廟、榮先陵置令、丞。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, directors and assistants were appointed for the Hall of Praising Virtue and the Tomb of Honoring the Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu directors and assistants were appointed for the Hall of Praising Virtue and the Tomb of Honoring the Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 四月庚寅，赦雍州。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin in the fourth month, Yongzhou was granted amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin in the fourth month Yongzhou was granted amnesty.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，右屯衞大將軍張仁亶為朔方道行軍大總管，以備突厥。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu in the fifth month, Zhang Renyuan, grand general of the Right Garrison Guard, was made campaign commander-in-chief of the Shuofang Route to guard against the Turks.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu in the fifth month Zhang Renyuan, grand general of the Right Garrison Guard, was appointed campaign commander-in-chief of the Shuofang Route to guard against the Turks.

sentences.zh: 丙午，假鴻臚卿臧思言使于突厥，死之。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Zang Siyan, acting director of the court of imperial entertainments, was sent as envoy to the Turks and died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingwu Zang Siyan, acting director of the court of imperial entertainments, was sent as envoy to the Turks and died.

sentences.zh: 以旱避正殿，減膳。

translations.literal: Because of drought the main hall was vacated and the imperial diet was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Because of drought the emperor vacated the main hall and reduced the imperial diet.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day dingmao in the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day dingmao in the sixth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚午，雨土于陝州。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, earth rained down at Shaanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengwu earth rained down at Shaanzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊子，吐蕃及姚州蠻寇邊，姚巂道討擊使唐九徵敗之。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, the Tibetans and the barbarians of Yaozhou raided the frontier. Tang Jiuzheng, punitive commissioner of the Yao-Yi Route, defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi the Tibetans and the barbarians of Yaozhou raided the frontier, and Tang Jiuzheng, punitive commissioner of the Yao-Yi Route, defeated them.

sentences.zh: 七月辛丑，皇太子以羽林千騎兵誅武三思，不克，死之。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou in the seventh month, the crown prince used a thousand Forest of Feathers cavalry to execute Wu Sansi, failed, and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinchou in the seventh month the crown prince used a thousand Forest of Feathers cavalry to execute Wu Sansi, failed, and was killed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，李嶠為中書令。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Li Jiao was made director of the secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu Li Jiao was appointed director of the secretariat.

sentences.zh: 八月丙戌，上尊號曰應天神龍皇帝，皇后曰順天翊聖皇后。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu in the eighth month, the honorific title Responsive-to-Heaven Divine Dragon Emperor was bestowed, and the empress was titled Responsive-to-Heaven Assisting Sage Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu in the eighth month the honorific title Responsive-to-Heaven Divine Dragon Emperor was bestowed, and the empress was titled Responsive-to-Heaven Assisting Sage Empress.

sentences.zh: 魏元忠罷。

translations.literal: Wei Yuanzhong was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Yuanzhong was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉，吏部侍郎蕭至忠為黃門侍郎，兵部尚書宗楚客，左衞將軍兼太府卿紀處訥：同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou in the ninth month, Xiao Zhizhong, vice minister of civil office, was made vice director of the gate guard. Zong Chuke, minister of war, and Ji Chune, general of the Left Guard and director of the grand treasury, were made associates of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou in the ninth month Xiao Zhizhong, vice minister of civil office, was appointed vice director of the gate guard. Zong Chuke, minister of war, and Ji Chune, general of the Left Guard and director of the grand treasury, were appointed associates of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 于惟謙罷。

translations.literal: Yu Weiqian was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Weiqian was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 庚子，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 賜文武官階、勳、爵。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted ranks, honors, and titles.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials were granted ranks, honors, and titles.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，楊再思為中書令，韋巨源、紀處訥為侍中。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai, Yang Zaisi was made director of the secretariat, and Wei Juyuan and Ji Chune were made palace attendants.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinhai Yang Zaisi was appointed director of the secretariat, and Wei Juyuan and Ji Chune were appointed palace attendants.

sentences.zh: 蘇瓌罷。

translations.literal: Su Gui was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Su Gui was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 十月戊寅，殺習藝館內教蘇安恆。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin in the tenth month, Su Anheng, inner instructor of the Practice Arts Hall, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin in the tenth month Su Anheng, inner instructor of the Practice Arts Hall, was killed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，有彗星出于西方。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, a comet appeared in the west.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu a comet appeared in the west.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙丑朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day yichou in the twelfth month, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day yichou in the twelfth month there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，雨土。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, earth rained down.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou earth rained down.

sentences.zh: 景龍二年二年二月癸未，有星隕于西南。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei in the second month of the second year of Jinglong, a star fell in the southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei in the second month of the second year of Jinglong a star fell in the southwest.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，大赦，進五品以上母、妻封號一等，無妻者授其女，婦人八十以上版授郡、縣、鄉君。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, a general amnesty was proclaimed. The mothers and wives of officials of the fifth rank and above were promoted one rank in enfeoffment. Those without wives had the title granted to their daughters. Women over eighty were granted official patents as commandery, county, or township lords.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengyin a general amnesty was proclaimed. The mothers and wives of officials of the fifth rank and above were promoted one rank in enfeoffment. Those without wives had the title granted to their daughters. Women over eighty were granted official patents as commandery, county, or township lords.

sentences.zh: 七月癸巳，朔方道行軍大總管張仁亶同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day guisi in the seventh month, Zhang Renyuan, campaign commander-in-chief of the Shuofang Route, was made associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi in the seventh month Zhang Renyuan, campaign commander-in-chief of the Shuofang Route, was appointed associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，有星孛于胃、昴。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, a broom star appeared in the Stomach and Hairy Head constellations.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou a broom star appeared in the Stomach and Hairy Head constellations.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申，西突厥寇邊，御史中丞馮嘉賓使于突厥，死之。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen in the eleventh month, the Western Turks raided the frontier. Feng Jiabin, vice censor-in-chief, was sent as envoy to the Turks and died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen in the eleventh month the Western Turks raided the frontier. Feng Jiabin, vice censor-in-chief, was sent as envoy to the Turks and died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，大赦，賜酺三日。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, a general amnesty was proclaimed, and a three-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao a general amnesty was proclaimed, and a three-day drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 癸未，安西都護牛師奬及西突厥戰于火燒城，死之。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, Niu Shijiang, protector-general of Anxi, fought the Western Turks at Huoshao city and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei Niu Shijiang, protector-general of Anxi, fought the Western Turks at Huoshao city and was killed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，皇后、妃、主、昭容賣官，行墨敕斜封。

translations.literal: That year the empress, consorts, princesses, and court ladies sold offices and issued black-edged imperial orders with diagonal seals.
translations.idiomatic: That year the empress, consorts, princesses, and court ladies sold offices and issued black-edged imperial orders with diagonal seals.

sentences.zh: 景龍三年三年二月己丑，及皇后幸玄武門，觀宮女拔河，為宮市以嬉。

translations.literal: On the day jichou in the second month of the third year of Jinglong, the emperor and empress visited the Xuanwu Gate to watch palace women tug-of-war, and set up a palace market for amusement.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jichou in the second month of the third year of Jinglong the emperor and empress visited the Xuanwu Gate to watch palace women tug-of-war, and set up a palace market for amusement.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，韋巨源為尚書左僕射，楊再思為右僕射：同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Wei Juyuan was made left vice director of the department of state affairs, and Yang Zaisi was made right vice director, both as associates of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin Wei Juyuan was appointed left vice director of the department of state affairs, and Yang Zaisi was appointed right vice director, both as associates of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 壬子，及皇后幸太常寺。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, the emperor and empress visited the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renzi the emperor and empress visited the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 三月戊午，宗楚客為中書令，蕭至忠守侍中，太府卿韋嗣立守兵部尚書、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu in the third month, Zong Chuke was made director of the secretariat. Xiao Zhizhong served as acting palace attendant. Wei Sili, director of the grand treasury, served as acting minister of war and associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuwu in the third month Zong Chuke was appointed director of the secretariat. Xiao Zhizhong served as acting palace attendant. Wei Sili, director of the grand treasury, served as acting minister of war and associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 中書侍郎兼檢校吏部侍郎崔湜，守兵部侍郎趙彥昭為中書侍郎：同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Cui Shi, vice director of the secretariat and supervisory vice minister of civil office, and Zhao Yanzhao, acting vice minister of war, were made vice directors of the secretariat and co-signatories of the Secretariat and Chancellery affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Shi, vice director of the secretariat and supervisory vice minister of civil office, and Zhao Yanzhao, acting vice minister of war, were appointed vice directors of the secretariat and co-signatories of the Secretariat and Chancellery affairs.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，禮部尚書韋溫為太子少保、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Wei Wen, minister of rites, was made junior tutor of the crown prince and associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuyin Wei Wen, minister of rites, was appointed junior tutor of the crown prince and associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 太常少卿鄭愔守吏部侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Zheng Yin, deputy director of the court of imperial sacrifices, served as acting vice minister of civil office and co-signatory of the Secretariat and Chancellery affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yin, deputy director of the court of imperial sacrifices, served as acting vice minister of civil office and co-signatory of the Secretariat and Chancellery affairs.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，貶崔湜為襄州刺吏，鄭愔江州司馬。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu in the fifth month, Cui Shi was demoted to prefect of Xiangzhou, and Zheng Yin to military aide of Jiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu in the fifth month Cui Shi was demoted to prefect of Xiangzhou, and Zheng Yin to military aide of Jiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 六月癸巳，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On the day guisi in the sixth month, Venus was visible during the day.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guisi in the sixth month Venus was visible during the day.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以旱避正殿，減膳，撤樂。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, because of drought the main hall was vacated, the imperial diet was reduced, and music was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengzi, because of drought, the emperor vacated the main hall, reduced the imperial diet, and suspended music.

sentences.zh: 詔括天下圖籍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the collection of maps and books throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the collection of maps and books throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renyin prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，楊再思薨。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Yang Zaisi died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao Yang Zaisi died.

sentences.zh: 七月丙辰，西突厥娑葛降。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen in the seventh month, Suoge of the Western Turks surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen in the seventh month Suoge of the Western Turks surrendered.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，許婦人非緣夫、子封者蔭其子孫。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, women who had received enfeoffment not through their husbands or sons were permitted to extend hereditary privileges to their descendants.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou women who had received enfeoffment not through their husbands or sons were permitted to extend hereditary privileges to their descendants.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，慮囚。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, prisoners were reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guihai prisoners were reviewed.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，澧水溢。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the Li River overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengchen the Li River overflowed.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，李嶠同中書門下三品，特進韋安石為侍中。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou in the eighth month, Li Jiao was made associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank, and Wei Anshi, special advancement, was made palace attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yiyou in the eighth month Li Jiao was appointed associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank, and Wei Anshi, special advancement, was appointed palace attendant.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，有星孛于紫宮。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, a broom star appeared in the Purple Palace constellation.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen a broom star appeared in the Purple Palace constellation.

sentences.zh: 九月戊辰，吏部尚書蘇瓌為尚書左僕射、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen in the ninth month, Su Gui, minister of civil office, was made left vice director of the department of state affairs and associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen in the ninth month Su Gui, minister of civil office, was appointed left vice director of the department of state affairs and associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙丑，有事于南郊，以皇后為亞獻，大赦，賜文武官階、爵，入品者減考，免關內今歲賦，賜酺三日。

translations.literal: On the day yichou in the eleventh month, sacrifices were performed at the southern suburb, with the empress as secondary offerer. A general amnesty was proclaimed. Civil and military officials were granted ranks and titles. Those who had entered the ranks had their evaluations reduced. This year's levies within the passes were remitted, and a three-day drinking feast was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yichou in the eleventh month sacrifices were performed at the southern suburb, with the empress as secondary offerer. A general amnesty was proclaimed. Civil and military officials were granted ranks and titles. Those who had entered the ranks had their evaluations reduced. This year's levies within the passes were remitted, and a three-day drinking feast was granted.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，豆盧欽望薨。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Dou Lu Qinwang died.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiaxu Dou Lu Qinwang died.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰，前宋國公致仕唐休璟為太子少師、同中書門下三品。

translations.literal: On the day renchen in the twelfth month, Tang Xiujing, retired former Duke of Song, was made junior preceptor of the crown prince and associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renchen in the twelfth month Tang Xiujing, retired former Duke of Song, was appointed junior preceptor of the crown prince and associate of the Secretariat and Chancellery of the third rank.

sentences.zh: 甲午，如新豐溫湯。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the emperor proceeded to the hot springs at Xinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiawu the emperor proceeded to the hot springs at Xinfeng.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，赦新豐，給復一年，賜從官勳一轉。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, Xinfeng was granted amnesty, corvée and tax levies were remitted for one year, and accompanying officials were granted one rotation of honors.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiachen Xinfeng was granted amnesty, corvée and tax levies were remitted for one year, and accompanying officials were granted one rotation of honors.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，至自新豐。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the emperor returned from Xinfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On the day yisi the emperor returned from Xinfeng.

sentences.zh: 景龍四年四年正月丙寅，及皇后微行以觀燈，遂幸蕭至忠第。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin in the first month of the fourth year of Jinglong, the emperor and empress went incognito to view the lanterns and then visited the residence of Xiao Zhizhong.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingyin in the first month of the fourth year of Jinglong the emperor and empress went incognito to view the lanterns and then visited the residence of Xiao Zhizhong.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，微行以觀燈，幸韋安石、長寧公主第。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the emperor went incognito to view the lanterns and visited the residences of Wei Anshi and the Princess of Changning.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao the emperor went incognito to view the lanterns and visited the residences of Wei Anshi and the Princess of Changning.

sentences.zh: 己卯，如始平。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, the emperor proceeded to Shiping.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jimao the emperor proceeded to Shiping.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，赦咸陽、始平，給復一年。

translations.literal: On the day renwu in the second month, Xianyang and Shiping were granted amnesty, and corvée and tax levies were remitted for one year.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu in the second month Xianyang and Shiping were granted amnesty, and corvée and tax levies were remitted for one year.

sentences.zh: 癸未，至自始平。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, the emperor returned from Shiping.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei the emperor returned from Shiping.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，及后、妃、公主觀三品以上拔河。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, the emperor, empress, consorts, and princesses watched officials of the third rank and above tug-of-war.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengxu the emperor, empress, consorts, and princesses watched officials of the third rank and above tug-of-war.

sentences.zh: 三月，以河源九曲予吐蕃。

translations.literal: In the third month, the nine bends of the Heyuan were granted to the Tibetans.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month the nine bends of the Heyuan were granted to the Tibetans.

sentences.zh: 庚申，雨木冰，井溢。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, trees were coated with ice and wells overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen trees were coated with ice and wells overflowed.

sentences.zh: 五月辛酉，封嗣虢王邕為汴王。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou in the fifth month, Yong, Prince of Guo, was enfeoffed as Prince of Bian.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinyou in the fifth month Yong, Prince of Guo, was enfeoffed as Prince of Bian.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，殺許州司兵參軍燕欽融。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Yan Qinrong, military staff officer of Xuzhou, was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingmao Yan Qinrong, military staff officer of Xuzhou, was killed.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，剡縣地震。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Shan county was shaken by an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingchou Shan county was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 六月，皇后及安樂公主、散騎常侍馬秦客反。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the empress, the Princess of Anle, and Ma Qinke, attendant cavalier, rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the empress, the Princess of Anle, and Ma Qinke, attendant cavalier, rebelled.

sentences.zh: 壬午，皇帝崩，年五十五，謚曰孝和皇帝。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the emperor died at the age of fifty-five. He was given the posthumous title Emperor Xiaohe.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu the emperor died at the age of fifty-five. He was given the posthumous title Emperor Xiaohe.

sentences.zh: 天寶十三載，加謚大和大聖大昭孝皇帝。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Tianbao, the posthumous title was augmented to Emperor Dahe Dasheng Dazhao Xiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Tianbao the posthumous title was augmented to Emperor Dahe Dasheng Dazhao Xiao.

sentences.zh: 【贊】贊曰：昔者孔子作春秋而亂臣賊子懼，其於弒君篡國之主，皆不黜絕之，豈以其盜而有之者，莫大之罪也，不沒其實，所以著其大惡而不隱歟？

translations.literal: [Commentary] The commentary says: In antiquity when Confucius composed the Spring and Autumn Annals, rebellious ministers and wicked sons were filled with fear. Regarding rulers who murdered their sovereigns and usurped the state, he did not expunge or cut them off. Was this not because those who seized possession of the realm had committed the greatest of crimes, and by not suppressing the facts he made their great wickedness known without concealment?
translations.idiomatic: [Commentary] The commentary says: In antiquity when Confucius composed the Spring and Autumn Annals, rebellious ministers and wicked sons were filled with fear. Regarding rulers who murdered their sovereigns and usurped the state, he did not expunge or cut them off. Was this not because those who seized possession of the realm had committed the greatest of crimes, and by not suppressing the facts he made their great wickedness known without concealment?

sentences.zh: 自司馬遷、班固皆作高后紀，呂氏雖非篡漢，而盜執其國政，遂不敢沒其實，豈其得聖人之意歟？

translations.literal: From Sima Qian and Ban Gu onward, all wrote annals for Empress Gao. Although the Lü clan did not usurp Han, they seized control of state affairs, and so the historians did not dare suppress the facts. Did they not grasp the intent of the sage?
translations.idiomatic: From Sima Qian and Ban Gu onward, all wrote annals for Empress Gao. Although the Lü clan did not usurp Han, they seized control of state affairs, and so the historians did not dare suppress the facts. Did they not grasp the intent of the sage?

sentences.zh: 抑亦偶合於春秋之法也。

translations.literal: Perhaps this also happened to accord with the method of the Spring and Autumn Annals.
translations.idiomatic: Perhaps this also happened to accord with the method of the Spring and Autumn Annals.

sentences.zh: 唐之舊史因之，列武后于本紀，蓋其所從來遠矣。

translations.literal: The old histories of Tang followed this precedent, listing Empress Wu in the basic annals. The practice surely reaches back to a distant origin.
translations.idiomatic: The old histories of Tang followed this precedent, listing Empress Wu in the basic annals. The practice surely reaches back to a distant origin.

sentences.zh: 夫吉凶之於人，猶影響也，而為善者得吉常多，其不幸而罹於凶者有矣；

translations.literal: Fortune and misfortune for a person are like shadow and echo, and those who do good usually receive fortune, though there are those who are unlucky and meet with misfortune;
translations.idiomatic: Fortune and misfortune for a person are like shadow and echo, and those who do good usually receive fortune, though there are those who are unlucky and meet with misfortune;

sentences.zh: 為惡者未始不及於凶，其幸而免者亦時有焉。

translations.literal: those who do evil never fail to encounter misfortune, though there are times when the fortunate escape it.
translations.idiomatic: those who do evil never fail to encounter misfortune, though there are times when the fortunate escape it.

sentences.zh: 而小人之慮，遂以為天道難知，為善未必福，而為惡未必禍也。

translations.literal: Yet the thinking of petty men concludes that the way of Heaven is hard to know, that doing good does not necessarily bring blessing, and that doing evil does not necessarily bring calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the thinking of petty men concludes that the way of Heaven is hard to know, that doing good does not necessarily bring blessing, and that doing evil does not necessarily bring calamity.

sentences.zh: 武后之惡，不及於大戮，所謂幸免者也。

translations.literal: The wickedness of Empress Wu did not reach the point of great execution. This is what is called a narrow escape.
translations.idiomatic: The wickedness of Empress Wu did not reach the point of great execution. This is what is called a narrow escape.

sentences.zh: 至中宗韋氏，則禍不旋踵矣。

translations.literal: As for Zhongzong and the Wei clan, calamity followed without delay.
translations.idiomatic: As for Zhongzong and the Wei clan, calamity followed without delay.

sentences.zh: 然其親遭母后之難，而躬自蹈之，所謂下愚之不移者歟！

translations.literal: Yet he personally suffered the disaster of his empress mother, and then trod the same path himself. Is this not what is called the immovable folly of the lowest?
translations.idiomatic: Yet he personally suffered the disaster of his empress mother, and then trod the same path himself. Is this not what is called the immovable folly of the lowest?
